30template <typename CommType>
31TMC9660<CommType>::TMC9660(CommType& comm, uint8_t address,
32 const BootloaderConfig* boot_cfg) noexcept
33 : comm_(comm), address_(address & 0x7F), bootCfg_(boot_cfg) {
34 // Auto-derive feature topology from the bootloader configuration when one was
35 // provided. This converts later "REPLY_CMD_NOT_AVAILABLE" silicon errors on
36 // SPI-encoder / Step-Dir paths into clear host-side ERROR logs at the API
37 // boundary. Y2 phase has no bootloader switch (it's a board topology fact),
38 // so it stays at the default true — boards without Y2 wired should call
39 // setCapabilities({.y2Phase=false, ...}) immediately after construction.
40 if (boot_cfg != nullptr) {
41 caps_.spiEncoder = boot_cfg->spiEnc.enable;
42 caps_.stepDir = boot_cfg->stepDir.enable;
43 }
44 // Initialize bootloader for SPI and UART interfaces
45 if (comm.mode() == CommMode::SPI || comm.mode() == CommMode::UART) {
46 bootloader_ = std::make_unique<TMC9660Bootloader<CommType>>(comm);
47 }
48}

103template <typename CommType>
104typename TMC9660<CommType>::BootloaderInitResult TMC9660<CommType>::bootloaderInit(const BootloaderConfig* cfg,
105 bool perform_reset,
106 bool retrieve_bootloader_info,
107 bool fail_on_verify_error) noexcept {
108 const BootloaderConfig* useCfg = cfg ? cfg : bootCfg_;
109 if (!useCfg)
110 return BootloaderInitResult::NoConfig;
111 if (!bootloader_) {
112 // Bootloader only works with SPI/UART interface
113 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
114 }
115
116 TMCLFrame statusFrame{};
117 statusFrame.opcode =
118 static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GetStatusScript); // GetStatusScript command
119
120 // ======================================================================
121 // STEP 1: Hardware Reset Sequence (if requested)
122 // ======================================================================
123 if (perform_reset) {
124 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Performing hardware reset sequence...");
125
126 // 1.1: Assert RST (active high) to enter reset state
127 if (!comm_.gpioSetActive(TMC9660CtrlPin::RST)) {
128 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to assert RST pin");
129 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
130 }
131 comm_.delayMs(10); // Hold reset for 10ms
132
133 // 1.2: Release RST to exit reset state
134 if (!comm_.gpioSetInactive(TMC9660CtrlPin::RST)) {
135 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to release RST pin");
136 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
137 }
138
139 // 1.3: Wait for FAULTN to go inactive (chip ready)
140 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "Waiting for FAULTN to go inactive (chip ready)...");
141 bool chip_ready = false;
142 for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) { // Timeout after 1 second
143 GpioSignal faultnSignal;
144 if (!comm_.gpioRead(TMC9660CtrlPin::FAULTN, faultnSignal)) {
145 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Failed to read FAULTN pin - continuing anyway");
146 break; // Don't fail, just continue without FAULTN monitoring
147 }
148
149 // FAULTN is active-low, so INACTIVE means chip is ready
150 if (faultnSignal == GpioSignal::INACTIVE) {
151 chip_ready = true;
152 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ FAULTN inactive - chip ready after %d ms",
153 i * 10);
154 break;
155 }
156 comm_.delayMs(10);
157 }
158
159 if (!chip_ready) {
160 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
161 "⚠️ FAULTN did not go inactive within timeout - continuing anyway");
162 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
163 " (FAULTN may not be configured or chip may be in different state)");
164 }
165
166 // Small delay for chip to fully stabilize in bootloader
167 comm_.delayMs(50);
168 } else {
169 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Skipping hardware reset (perform_reset=false)");
170 }
171
172 // ======================================================================
173 // STEP 2: Detect Current Mode (Bootloader vs Parameter Mode)
174 // ======================================================================
175 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Detecting chip mode (bootloader vs parameter)...");
176
177 // Additional delay for UART communication to stabilize after reset
178 // UART requires more setup time than SPI
179 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::UART) {
180 comm_.delayMs(100);
181 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "UART mode: Added 100ms stabilization delay");
182 }
183
184 bool in_bootloader_mode = false;
185 bool in_parameter_mode = false;
186
187 TMCLReply firstReply{}, finalReply{};
188 bool tmclSuccess = comm_.transferTMCL(statusFrame, finalReply, address_, &firstReply, nullptr);
189
190 uint8_t raw_status = firstReply.rawBytes[0];
191 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "First reply raw status: 0x%02X (TMCL parse %s)",
192 raw_status, tmclSuccess ? "succeeded" : "failed");
193
194 // For UART: If TMCL transfer completely failed (no response), chip is likely in bootloader mode
195 // For SPI: Always get a response due to full-duplex nature, check status codes
196 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::UART && !tmclSuccess) {
197 in_bootloader_mode = true;
198 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in BOOTLOADER mode (UART: no TMCL response)");
199 } else if (raw_status == 0x13) {
200 in_bootloader_mode = true;
201 uint32_t version = firstReply.extractRawValue(1);
202 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
203 "Chip in BOOTLOADER mode (SESSION_START), version: %d.%d",
204 (version >> 16) & 0xFFFF, version & 0xFFFF);
205 } else if (raw_status == 0x0C) {
206 in_parameter_mode = true;
207 uint32_t version = tmclSuccess ? firstReply.value : firstReply.extractRawValue(1);
208 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in PARAMETER mode (FIRST_CMD), version: %d.%d",
209 (version >> 16) & 0xFFFF, version & 0xFFFF);
210 } else if (raw_status == 0xFF && tmclSuccess &&
211 (firstReply.status == 100 || firstReply.status == 101)) {
212 in_parameter_mode = true;
213 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in PARAMETER mode (initialized)");
214 } else if (raw_status == 0x00 && comm_.mode() == CommMode::SPI) {
215 // For SPI: 0x00 can indicate bootloader OK status
216 in_bootloader_mode = true;
217 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in BOOTLOADER mode (SPI: OK status 0x00)");
218 } else if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::SPI) {
219 /* Undriven / pull-up MISO often reads 0xFF. UART already treats “no TMCL”
220 * as a bootloader probe; do the same on SPI so applyConfiguration / NO_OP
221 * can continue instead of hard-failing mode detect. */
222 in_bootloader_mode = true;
223 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
224 "SPI mode unknown (status 0x%02X, TMCL %s) — trying bootloader path",
225 raw_status, tmclSuccess ? "succeeded" : "failed");
226 } else {
227 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660",
228 "Unable to detect chip mode (unknown status: 0x%02X, TMCL %s)", raw_status,
229 tmclSuccess ? "succeeded" : "failed");
230 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
231 }
232
233 // ======================================================================
234 // STEP 3: Handle Parameter Mode Scenarios
235 // ======================================================================
236 if (in_parameter_mode && !in_bootloader_mode) {
237 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
238 "Chip in parameter mode, transitioning to bootloader...");
239
240 // Send Boot command to enter bootloader
241 if (!enterBootloaderMode()) {
242 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to send Boot command");
243 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
244 }
245
246 // Wait for transition to complete
247 comm_.delayMs(150);
248
249 // Verify we're now in bootloader mode
250 uint32_t reply_after_boot = 0;
251 if (!bootloader_->noOp(&reply_after_boot)) {
252 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to verify bootloader mode after Boot command");
253 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
254 }
255
256 uint8_t statusAfterBoot = static_cast<uint8_t>((reply_after_boot >> 24) & 0xFF);
257 if (statusAfterBoot != 0x15) { // BOOTLOADER_RESUMED status
258 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Expected BOOTLOADER_RESUMED (0x15), got 0x%02X",
259 statusAfterBoot);
260 } else {
261 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Successfully entered bootloader mode");
262 }
263
264 in_bootloader_mode = true;
265 }
266
267 // ======================================================================
268 // STEP 4: Apply Configuration via Bootloader
269 // ======================================================================
270 if (in_bootloader_mode || !in_parameter_mode) {
271
272 // ======================================================================
273 // STEP 4.5: Retrieve Bootloader Information (if requested)
274 // ======================================================================
275 if (retrieve_bootloader_info) {
276 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Retrieving bootloader information...");
277 if (!bootloader_->getAllBootloaderInfo()) {
278 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Failed to retrieve some bootloader information");
279 }
280 } else {
281 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
282 "Skipping bootloader information retrieval (retrieve_bootloader_info=false)");
283 }
284
285 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Applying bootloader configuration...");
286 if (!bootloader_->applyConfiguration(*useCfg, fail_on_verify_error)) {
287 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to apply bootloader configuration");
288 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
289 }
290 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Bootloader configuration applied successfully");
291 }
292
293 // ======================================================================
294 // STEP 5: Check if motor control should be started
295 // ======================================================================
296 if (!useCfg->boot.start_motor_control) {
297 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
298 "✅ Bootloader initialization complete (motor control NOT started)");
299 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
300 " cfg.boot.start_motor_control=false - chip remains in bootloader mode");
301 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", " Call bootloader_->startMotorControl() when ready");
302 return BootloaderInitResult::Success;
303 }
304
305 // Motor control will be started automatically by Bootloader after applyConfiguration() when
306 // cfg.boot.start_motor_control=true is written to the boot config register
307 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Bootloader initialization complete");
308 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
309 " Motor control started automatically via cfg.boot.start_motor_control=true");
310
311 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Waiting for initialization...");
312 comm_.delayMs(100);
313
314 // ======================================================================
315 // STEP 7: Wait for Motor Control Initialization and Verify Communication
316 // ======================================================================
317 // For SPI: Consume SESSION_START and wait for SPI_STATUS_OK
318 // For UART: Simply verify TMCL communication works (no status codes)
319
320 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::SPI) {
321 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
322 "SPI mode: Waiting for SESSION_START and consuming status codes...");
323
324 // Poll for chip readiness and SESSION_START (SPI-specific)
325 bool session_start_received = false;
326 for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 50; ++attempt) { // Timeout after 5 seconds (50 * 100ms)
327 TMCLReply firstReply2{}, finalReply2{};
328 comm_.transferTMCL(statusFrame, finalReply2, address_, &firstReply2, nullptr);
329
330 uint8_t rawStatus2 = finalReply2.rawBytes[0]; // Check the reply to the CURRENT command
331 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "Attempt %d/50: Current reply raw status: 0x%02X",
332 attempt + 1, rawStatus2);
333
334 if (rawStatus2 == 0x0C) {
335 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
336 "✅ Parameter mode SESSION_START (0x0C) received after %d attempts",
337 attempt + 1);
338 session_start_received = true;
339 break;
340 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0xFF) {
341 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
342 "✅ SPI_STATUS_OK (0xFF) received after %d attempts - chip ready",
343 attempt + 1);
344 session_start_received = true;
345 break;
346 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0xF0) {
347 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "SPI_STATUS_NOT_READY (0xF0) - waiting...");
348 comm_.delayMs(100);
349 continue;
350 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0x13) {
351 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
352 "⚠️ Still in bootloader mode (0x13) - motor control not ready yet");
353 comm_.delayMs(100);
354 continue;
355 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0x00) {
356 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
357 "⚠️ Bootloader OK (0x00) - motor control not ready yet");
358 comm_.delayMs(100);
359 continue;
360 } else {
361 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Unexpected status 0x%02X - waiting...",
362 rawStatus2);
363 comm_.delayMs(100);
364 continue;
365 }
366 }
367
368 if (!session_start_received) {
369 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660",
370 "❌ Timeout waiting for SESSION_START or SPI_STATUS_OK");
371 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Motor control may not have started properly");
372 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
373 }
374 } else {
375 // UART mode: No SESSION_START or status codes, just wait for motor control to initialize
376 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
377 "UART mode: Waiting for motor control initialization...");
378 comm_.delayMs(100); // Give motor control time to start (adjust as needed)
379 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Motor control initialization delay completed");
380 }
381
382 // ======================================================================
383 // STEP 8: Verify TMCL Communication with GetVersion
384 // ======================================================================
385 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Verifying TMCL communication with GetVersion...");
386
387 // First, for UART mode, let's verify we're NOT still in bootloader mode
388 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::UART) {
389 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
390 "UART mode: Testing if chip is still in bootloader mode...");
391 tmc9660::BootloaderVersion bootloaderVer;
392 if (bootloader_->getBootloaderVersion(&bootloaderVer)) {
393 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "❌ ERROR: Chip is STILL in bootloader mode!");
394 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Bootloader version: %d.%d", bootloaderVer.major,
395 bootloaderVer.minor);
396 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Motor control did NOT start properly");
397 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660",
398 " Check boot configuration: cfg.boot.start_motor_control should be true");
399 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
400 } else {
401 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
402 "✅ Bootloader commands fail (good - we're in parameter mode)");
403 }
404 }
405
406 // Try a simple command first (MST - Motor Stop)
407 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Testing TMCL communication with MST (Motor Stop)...");
408 if (!sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::MST, 0, 0, 0, nullptr)) {
409 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "❌ TMCL communication failed (MST command failed)");
410 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Motor control is not responding to TMCL commands");
411 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
412 }
413 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ MST command successful - TMCL communication working!");
414
415 // Now try GetVersion
416 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Getting firmware version with GetVersion...");
417 uint32_t version = 0;
418 if (!sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GetVersion, 0, 0, 0, &version)) {
419 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "❌ GetVersion failed (but MST worked)");
420 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Basic TMCL works, but GetVersion has issues");
421 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
422 }
423
424 // GetVersion success is already logged in sendCommand() with the version string
425 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ TMCL communication verified - GetVersion successful");
426 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
427 "✅ Chip fully initialized and ready for motor control commands");
428
429 return BootloaderInitResult::Success;
430}

484namespace detail {
486inline uint8_t impliedGlobalBank(
487 const std::variant<uint8_t, tmc9660::tmcl::GlobalParamBank0, tmc9660::tmcl::GlobalParamBank2,
488 tmc9660::tmcl::GlobalParamBank3>& id) noexcept {
489 return std::visit(
490 [](auto&& arg) -> uint8_t {
491 using T = std::decay_t<decltype(arg)>;
492 if constexpr (tmc9660::tmcl::IsGlobalParamBank<T>) {
493 return tmc9660::tmcl::kGlobalBankOf<T>;
494 } else {
495 return 0xFFU;
496 }
497 },
498 id);
499}
500} // namespace detail
501
502template <typename CommType>
503bool TMC9660<CommType>::writeGlobalParameter(GlobalParamBankVariant id, uint8_t bank,
504 uint32_t value) noexcept {
505 const uint8_t implied = detail::impliedGlobalBank(id);
506 if (implied != 0xFFU && implied != bank) {
507 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "SGP rejected: id belongs to bank %u, not bank %u",
508 static_cast<unsigned>(implied), static_cast<unsigned>(bank));
509 return false;
510 }
511 uint16_t paramId =
512 std::visit([](auto&& arg) -> uint16_t { return static_cast<uint16_t>(arg); }, id);
513 return this->sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SGP, paramId, bank, value, nullptr);
514}
515
528template <typename CommType>
529bool TMC9660<CommType>::readGlobalParameter(GlobalParamBankVariant id, uint8_t bank,
530 uint32_t& value) noexcept {

532 if (implied != 0xFFU && implied != bank) {
533 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "GGP rejected: id belongs to bank %u, not bank %u",
534 static_cast<unsigned>(implied), static_cast<unsigned>(bank));
535 return false;
536 }
537 uint16_t paramId =
538 std::visit([](auto&& arg) -> uint16_t { return static_cast<uint16_t>(arg); }, id);
539 return this->sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GGP, paramId, bank, 0, &value);
540}

542//--------------------------------------------------------------------------
543// Batched (pipelined) parameter access
544//--------------------------------------------------------------------------
545
546template <typename CommType>
547bool TMC9660<CommType>::sendCommandBatch(std::span<const TMCLFrame> requests,
548 std::span<TMCLReply> replies,
549 size_t* completed) noexcept {
550 if constexpr (requires(CommType& c, std::span<const TMCLFrame> rq, std::span<TMCLReply> rp,
551 uint8_t a, size_t* n) { c.transferTMCLBatch(rq, rp, a, n); }) {
552 return comm_.transferTMCLBatch(requests, replies, address_, completed);
553 } else {
554 // Transport without a batch primitive: plain request/reply loop.
555 if (completed != nullptr) {
556 *completed = 0;
557 }
558 if (replies.size() < requests.size()) {
559 return false;
560 }
561 for (size_t i = 0; i < requests.size(); ++i) {
562 if (!comm_.transferTMCL(requests[i], replies[i], address_, nullptr, nullptr)) {
563 return false;
564 }
565 if (completed != nullptr) {
566 *completed = i + 1;
567 }
568 }
569 return true;
570 }
571}
572
573namespace detail {
575inline constexpr size_t kBatchChunk = 16;
576} // namespace detail
577
578template <typename CommType>
579template <typename Item, typename MakeFrame, typename Store>
580bool TMC9660<CommType>::runBatch(std::span<Item> items, MakeFrame make_frame,
581 Store store) noexcept {
582 bool all_ok = true;
583 std::array<TMCLFrame, detail::kBatchChunk> frames{};
584 std::array<TMCLReply, detail::kBatchChunk> replies{};
585 for (size_t base = 0; base < items.size(); base += detail::kBatchChunk) {
586 const size_t n = std::min(detail::kBatchChunk, items.size() - base);
587 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
588 frames[i] = make_frame(items[base + i]);
589 }
590 size_t done = 0;
591 const bool transport_ok =
592 sendCommandBatch(std::span<const TMCLFrame>(frames.data(), n),
593 std::span<TMCLReply>(replies.data(), n), &done);
594 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
595 Item& item = items[base + i];
596 if (i < done) {
597 item.status = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode>(replies[i].status);
598 if (replies[i].isOK()) {
599 store(item, replies[i].value);
600 } else {
601 all_ok = false;
602 }
603 } else {
604 item.status = tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode::REPLY_CHKERR;
605 all_ok = false;
606 }
607 }
608 if (!transport_ok) {
609 for (size_t i = base + n; i < items.size(); ++i) {
610 items[i].status = tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode::REPLY_CHKERR;
611 }
612 return false;
613 }
614 }
615 return all_ok;
616}

618template <typename CommType>
619bool TMC9660<CommType>::readParameters(std::span<ParameterAccess> items) noexcept {
620 return runBatch(
621 items,
622 [](const ParameterAccess& a) {
623 TMCLFrame f{};
624 f.opcode = static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GAP);
625 f.type = static_cast<uint16_t>(a.id);
626 f.motor = a.motor;
627 return f;
628 },
629 [](ParameterAccess& a, uint32_t v) { a.value = v; });
630}

647template <typename CommType>

650 items,
651 [](const GlobalParameterAccess& a) {
652 TMCLFrame f{};
653 f.opcode = static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GGP);
654 f.type = a.id;
655 f.motor = a.bank;
656 return f;
657 },
658 [](GlobalParameterAccess& a, uint32_t v) { a.value = v; });
659}

661template <typename CommType>
662bool TMC9660<CommType>::writeGlobalParameters(std::span<GlobalParameterAccess> items) noexcept {
663 return runBatch(
664 items,
665 [](const GlobalParameterAccess& a) {
666 TMCLFrame f{};
667 f.opcode = static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SGP);
668 f.type = a.id;
669 f.motor = a.bank;
670 f.value = a.value;
671 return f;
672 },
673 [](GlobalParameterAccess&, uint32_t) {});

707template <typename CommType>
708bool TMC9660<CommType>::sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op opcode, uint16_t type, uint8_t motor, uint32_t value,
709 uint32_t* reply, tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode* out_tmcl_status) noexcept {
710 TMCLFrame tx{};
711 tx.opcode = static_cast<uint8_t>(opcode);
712 tx.type = type;
713 tx.motor = motor;
714 tx.value = value;
715
716#ifndef TMC9660_DISABLE_DEBUG_LOGGING
717 // Per-access name lookup and formatting; compiled out with TMC9660_DISABLE_DEBUG_LOGGING.
718 // Debug logging for TMCL frame assembly
719 const char* opName = tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Op>(tx.opcode));
720
721 // Format type field based on the operation type
722 char typeStr[80];
723 switch (tx.opcode) {
724 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SAP): // Set Axis Parameter
725 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GAP): // Get Axis Parameter
726 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::AAP): // Accumulator to Axis Parameter
727 {
728 const char* paramName =
729 tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters>(tx.type));
730 snprintf(typeStr, sizeof(typeStr), "%s (0x%04X, %u)", paramName, tx.type, tx.type);
731 } break;
732 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SGP): // Set Global Parameter
733 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GGP): // Get Global Parameter
734 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::AGP): // Accumulator to Global Parameter
735 snprintf(typeStr, sizeof(typeStr), "GlobalParam=0x%04X", tx.type);
736 break;
737 default:
738 snprintf(typeStr, sizeof(typeStr), "0x%04X", tx.type);
739 break;
740 }
741
742 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660",
743 "[TMCL TX] %s (Op=0x%02X), Type=%s, Motor=0x%02X, Value=0x%08X", opName,
744 tx.opcode, typeStr, tx.motor, tx.value);
745#endif
746
747 TMCLReply rep{};
748 if (!comm_.transferTMCL(tx, rep, address_, nullptr, nullptr)) {
749 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "[TMCL] Transfer failed");
750 if (out_tmcl_status)
751 *out_tmcl_status = tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode::REPLY_CHKERR;
752 return false;
753 }
754 if (out_tmcl_status)
755 *out_tmcl_status = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode>(rep.status);
756
757#ifndef TMC9660_DISABLE_DEBUG_LOGGING
758 // Debug logging for TMCL reply with decoded status and opcode
759 // Note: SPI response format: byte0=SPI_STATUS, byte1=TMCL_STATUS, byte2=OPCODE, byte3-6=VALUE,
760 // byte7=CHECKSUM
761 const char* statusName =
762 tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode>(rep.status));
763 const char* rxOpName = tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Op>(rep.opcode));
764 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(
765 comm_, 3, "TMC9660",
766 "[TMCL RX] %s (SPI_Status=0x%02X, TMCL_Status=0x%02X), Op=%s (0x%02X), Value=0x%08X",
767 statusName, static_cast<uint8_t>(rep.spi_status), rep.status, rxOpName, rep.opcode, rep.value);
768#endif
769
770 // Special handling for GetVersion command (Type=0 returns string format)
771 if (opcode == tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GetVersion && type == 0) {
772 std::string versionString = rep.getVersionString();
773 if (!versionString.empty()) {
774 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ GetVersion successful - Firmware version: %s",
775 versionString.c_str());
776 if (reply)
777 *reply = 0; // No numeric value for string format
778 return true;
779 } else {
780 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
781 "⚠️ GetVersion string format not detected, trying standard parsing");
782 }
783 }
784
785 if (!rep.isOK()) {
786 // Distinguish between SPI communication failure and TMCL command failure
787 if (rep.spi_status == SPIStatus::OK) {
788 // SPI communication successful, but TMCL command failed
789 const char* tmclStatusName =
790 tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode>(rep.status));
791 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "[TMCL] Command failed: %s (TMCL_Status=0x%02X)",
792 tmclStatusName, rep.status);
793 } else {
794 // SPI communication failure
795 const char* spiStatusStr = "UNKNOWN";
796 switch (rep.spi_status) {
797 case SPIStatus::CHECKSUM_ERROR:
798 spiStatusStr = "CHECKSUM_ERROR";
799 break;
800 case SPIStatus::NOT_READY:
801 spiStatusStr = "NOT_READY";
802 break;
803 case SPIStatus::FIRST_CMD:
804 spiStatusStr = "FIRST_CMD";
805 break;
806 default:
807 spiStatusStr = "UNKNOWN";
808 break;
809 }
810 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
811 "[TMCL] SPI communication failed: %s (SPI_Status=0x%02X)", spiStatusStr,
812 static_cast<uint8_t>(rep.spi_status));
813 }
814 return false;
815 }
816 if (reply)
817 *reply = rep.value;
818 return true;
819}

888template <typename CommType>
889bool TMC9660<CommType>::MotorConfig::configureAuto(const MotorProfile& profile) noexcept {
890 bool ok = true;
891
892 // --- Safety Check: Ensure critical parameters are valid ---
893 if (profile.maxPhaseCurrent_A <= 0.0f || profile.pwmFrequency_Hz < 10000 ||
894 profile.pwmFrequency_Hz > 100000 ||
895 (profile.motorType == tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR && profile.polePairs == 0) ||
896 (profile.motorType == tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::STEPPER_MOTOR && profile.polePairs == 0)) {
897 return false;
898 }
899
900 // Step 1: Set commutation mode to SYSTEM_OFF (required before changing motor type)
901 ok &= setCommutationMode(tmc9660::tmcl::CommutationMode::SYSTEM_OFF);
902
903 // Step 2: Set motor type and pole pairs
904 ok &= setType(profile.motorType, profile.polePairs);
905
906 // Step 3: Set motor direction
907 ok &= setDirection(profile.direction);
908
909 // Step 4: Set PWM frequency
910 ok &= setPWMFrequency(profile.pwmFrequency_Hz);
911
912 // Step 5: Set PWM switching scheme (with smart defaults based on motor type)
913 tmc9660::tmcl::PwmSwitchingScheme pwmScheme = profile.pwmSwitchingScheme;
914 // Auto-select default based on motor type if SVPWM is set for non-BLDC motors
915 if (profile.motorType != tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR &&
916 pwmScheme == tmc9660::tmcl::PwmSwitchingScheme::SVPWM) {
917 // SVPWM is only valid for BLDC motors, use STANDARD for DC/Stepper
918 pwmScheme = tmc9660::tmcl::PwmSwitchingScheme::STANDARD;
919 }
920 ok &= setPWMSwitchingScheme(pwmScheme);
921
922 // Step 6: Set idle motor PWM behavior
923 ok &= setIdleMotorPWMBehavior(profile.idlePwmBehavior);
924
925 // Step 7: Calculate and set MAX_TORQUE from max_phase_current_a
926 uint16_t maxTorque_mA = static_cast<uint16_t>(profile.maxPhaseCurrent_A * 1000.0f + 0.5f);
927 ok &= setMaxTorqueCurrent(maxTorque_mA);
928
929 // Step 8: Calculate and set MAX_FLUX
930 // For DC motors, flux is not used (but we still set it to avoid issues)
931 // For BLDC/Stepper, default to 20% of max phase current if not specified
932 float maxFlux_A = profile.maxFluxCurrent_A;
933 if (std::isnan(maxFlux_A) || maxFlux_A <= 0.0f) {
934 if (profile.motorType == tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::DC_MOTOR) {
935 maxFlux_A = 0.0f; // DC motors don't use flux
936 } else {
937 maxFlux_A = profile.maxPhaseCurrent_A * 0.2f; // 20% default for BLDC/Stepper
938 }
939 }
940 uint16_t maxFlux_mA = static_cast<uint16_t>(maxFlux_A * 1000.0f + 0.5f);
941 ok &= setMaxFluxCurrent(maxFlux_mA);
942
943 // Step 9: Set output voltage limit
944 ok &= setOutputVoltageLimit(profile.outputVoltageLimit);
945
946 // Step 10: Apply commutation mode if specified (applied last, after all configuration)
947 // This allows users to set the desired commutation mode (e.g., FOC_HALL, FOC_ENCODER)
948 // which will be applied after all motor parameters are configured
949 if (profile.commutationMode.has_value()) {
950 ok &= setCommutationMode(profile.commutationMode.value());
951 }
952
953 return ok;
954}

1162template <typename CommType>
1163bool TMC9660<CommType>::CurrentSensing::setOffsets(int16_t offset0, int16_t offset1, int16_t offset2,
1164 int16_t offset3) noexcept {
1165 bool ok = true;

1169 static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(offset1)));
1170 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::ADC_I2_OFFSET,
1171 static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(offset2)));
1172 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::ADC_I3_OFFSET,
1173 static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(offset3)));

1215template <typename CommType>
1216bool TMC9660<CommType>::CurrentSensing::calibrateOffsets(bool waitForCompletion,
1217 uint32_t timeoutMs) noexcept {
1218 using tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags;
1219 using tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters;
1220 // Clear the calibrated flag to trigger a new calibration cycle
1221 if (!driver.writeParameter(
1222 Parameters::GENERAL_STATUS_FLAGS,
1223 static_cast<uint32_t>(GeneralStatusFlags::ADC_OFFSET_CALIBRATED)))
1224 return false;
1225
1226 if (!waitForCompletion)
1227 return true;
1228
1229 uint32_t elapsedMs = 0;
1230 const uint32_t pollIntervalMs = 10;
1231 bool done = false;
1232 while (elapsedMs < timeoutMs) {
1233 if (!getCalibrationStatus(done))
1234 return false;
1235 if (done)
1236 return true;
1237 driver.comm_.delayMs(pollIntervalMs);
1238 elapsedMs += pollIntervalMs;
1239 }
1240 return false;
1241}
1242
1243template <typename CommType>
1244bool TMC9660<CommType>::CurrentSensing::getCalibrationStatus(bool& isCalibrated) noexcept {
1245 uint32_t flags;
1246 if (!driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::GENERAL_STATUS_FLAGS, flags))
1247 return false;
1248 isCalibrated =
1249 (flags & static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags::ADC_OFFSET_CALIBRATED)) !=
1250 0;
1251 return true;
1252}
1253
1254template <typename CommType>
1255bool TMC9660<CommType>::CurrentSensing::configureAuto(const AutoConfig& config) noexcept {
1256 // Convert mΩ to Ω
1257 const float R_shunt_Ohm = config.shuntResistance_mOhm / 1000.0f;
1258
1259 // Available CSA gains and their numeric values
1260 struct CsaGainOption {
1261 tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain gain;
1262 float numericGain;
1263 };
1264
1265 // Search HIGHEST→LOWEST gain so we pick the largest gain that still has
1266 // sufficient full-scale headroom. Higher gain ⇒ lower I_FS but proportionally
1267 // better ADC resolution per ampere (CURRENT_SCALING_FACTOR scales 1/G).
1268 // For low-current motors (e.g. 30 W BLDC drawing tens of mA in steady state)
1269 // this can be 8× better resolution than the legacy "lowest qualifying gain"
1270 // strategy and is standard practice for shunt-based sensorless drives.
1271 const CsaGainOption availableGains[] = {
1272 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_40X, 40.0f},
1273 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_20X, 20.0f},
1274 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_10X, 10.0f},
1275 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_5X, 5.0f},
1276 };
1277
1278 // Calculate full-scale current for each gain: I_FS = 2.5V / (G_CSA * R_shunt)
1279 // We want I_FS to be at least 1.5x the expected peak current for headroom
1280 const float minHeadroom = 1.5f;
1281 const float targetIFS = config.expectedPeakCurrent_A * minHeadroom;
1282
1283 // Find the best CSA gain — the HIGHEST gain whose full-scale current still
1284 // exceeds the headroom target (best resolution without saturating).
1285 // Fallback: if none qualify (e.g. very high peak current), keep GAIN_5X
1286 // which has the largest I_FS.
1287 tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain selectedGain = tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_5X;
1288 float selectedGainValue = 5.0f;
1289 bool foundSuitableGain = false;
1290
1291 for (const auto& option : availableGains) {
1292 const float I_FS = 2.5f / (option.numericGain * R_shunt_Ohm);
1293 if (I_FS >= targetIFS && !foundSuitableGain) {
1294 selectedGain = option.gain;
1295 selectedGainValue = option.numericGain;
1296 foundSuitableGain = true;
1297 }
1298 }
1299
1300 // Calculate CURRENT_SCALING_FACTOR
1301 // Formula: Factor = 39.06 / (G_CSA * R_shunt_Ohm) for PEAK
1302 // Factor = 27.62 / (G_CSA * R_shunt_Ohm) for RMS
1303 const float scaling_factor = config.usePeakScaling ? (39.06f / (selectedGainValue * R_shunt_Ohm))
1304 : (27.62f / (selectedGainValue * R_shunt_Ohm));
1305
1306 // Clamp to valid range [1, 65535]
1307 uint16_t scalingFactorInt;
1308 if (scaling_factor < 1.0f) {
1309 scalingFactorInt = 1;
1310 } else if (scaling_factor > 65535.0f) {
1311 scalingFactorInt = 65535;
1312 } else {
1313 scalingFactorInt = static_cast<uint16_t>(scaling_factor + 0.5f); // Round to nearest
1314 }
1315
1316 // Configure all parameters
1317 bool ok = true;
1318
1319 // 1. Set shunt type
1320 ok &= setShuntType(config.shuntType);
1321
1322 // 2. Set CSA gain
1323 ok &= setCSAGain(selectedGain, selectedGain);
1324
1325 // 3. Set CSA filter
1326 ok &= setCSAFilter(config.csaFilter, config.csaFilter);
1327
1328 // 4. Set current scaling factor (this is the key parameter!)
1329 ok &= setScalingFactor(scalingFactorInt);
1330
1331 // 5. Set phase ADC mapping (use defaults if not specified: U->I0, V->I1, W->I2, Y2->I3)
1332 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapU =
1333 config.phaseU_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I0);
1334 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapV =
1335 config.phaseV_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I1);
1336 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapW =
1337 config.phaseW_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I2);
1338 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapY2 =
1339 config.phaseY2_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I3);
1340 ok &= setPhaseAdcMapping(mapU, mapV, mapW, mapY2);
1341
1342 // 6. Calculate and set individual ADC scaling factors based on actual shunt resistances
1343 // ADC_Ix_SCALE compensates for physical mismatch in shunt resistors and CSA amplifier tolerances.
1344 // Formula: ADC_Ix_SCALE = 1024 * (R_nominal / R_actual)
1345 // If actual resistance is not provided (NaN or <= 0), use nominal value (no compensation).
1346 constexpr float defaultScale = 1024.0f;
1347 constexpr float minScale = 1.0f;
1348 constexpr float maxScale = 32767.0f;
1349
1350 auto calculateScale = [&config, defaultScale, minScale,
1351 maxScale](float actualR_mOhm) -> uint16_t {
1352 // Normalize: use nominal if not provided or invalid
1353 if (std::isnan(actualR_mOhm) || actualR_mOhm <= 0.0f) {
1354 actualR_mOhm = config.shuntResistance_mOhm;
1355 }
1356
1357 // Calculate and clamp in one step
1358 float scale = defaultScale * (config.shuntResistance_mOhm / actualR_mOhm);
1359 if (scale < minScale)
1360 scale = minScale;
1361 else if (scale > maxScale)
1362 scale = maxScale;
1363
1364 return static_cast<uint16_t>(scale + 0.5f);
1365 };
1366
1367 uint16_t scale0 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc0_mOhm); // ADC_I0
1368 uint16_t scale1 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc1_mOhm); // ADC_I1
1369 uint16_t scale2 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc2_mOhm); // ADC_I2
1370 uint16_t scale3 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc3_mOhm); // ADC_I3
1371
1372 ok &= setScalingFactors(scale0, scale1, scale2, scale3);
1373
1374 // 7. Set ADC inversion (use Table 24 defaults if not specified, allow override)
1375 // Table 24: Standard ADC inversion table for usage with internal CSA
1376 // DC: ADC_I0=Inverted, ADC_I1=Not inverted
1377 // BLDC: ADC_I0=Inverted, ADC_I1=Inverted, ADC_I2=Inverted
1378 // Stepper: ADC_I0=Inverted, ADC_I1=Not inverted, ADC_I2=Inverted, ADC_I3=Not inverted
1379 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv0_default, inv1_default, inv2_default, inv3_default;
1380 switch (config.motorType) {
1381 case tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::DC_MOTOR:
1382 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I0 (UX1)
1383 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I1 (VX2)
1384 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I2 (not used for DC)
1385 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I3 (not used for DC)
1386 break;
1387 case tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR:
1388 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I0 (UX1)
1389 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I1 (VX2)
1390 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I2 (WY1)
1391 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I3 (Y2, not used for BLDC)
1392 break;
1393 case tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::STEPPER_MOTOR:
1394 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I0 (UX1)
1395 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I1 (VX2)
1396 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I2 (WY1)
1397 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I3 (Y2)
1398 break;
1399 default:
1400 // NO_MOTOR or unknown: use BLDC defaults as safe fallback
1401 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED;
1402 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED;
1403 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED;
1404 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED;
1405 break;
1406 }
1407
1408 // Use user-specified inversion if provided, otherwise use defaults
1409 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv0 = config.adc0_inverted.value_or(inv0_default);
1410 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv1 = config.adc1_inverted.value_or(inv1_default);
1411 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv2 = config.adc2_inverted.value_or(inv2_default);
1412 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv3 = config.adc3_inverted.value_or(inv3_default);
1413 ok &= setInversion(inv0, inv1, inv2, inv3);
1414
1415 // 8. Optionally calibrate ADC offsets
1416 // Note: Offsets are not set manually - they are calibrated by the TMC9660 hardware.
1417 // The calibration requires the motor to be stationary and commutation to be off (SYSTEM_OFF).
1418 if (config.autoCalibrate) {
1419 // Trigger calibration and wait for completion
1420 if (!calibrateOffsets(true, config.calibrationTimeoutMs)) {
1421 return false; // Calibration failed or timed out
1422 }
1423
1424 // Verify calibration was successful by checking the ADC_OFFSET_CALIBRATED flag
1425 bool isCalibrated = false;
1426 if (!getCalibrationStatus(isCalibrated)) {
1427 return false; // Failed to read calibration status
1428 }
1429 if (!isCalibrated) {
1430 return false; // Calibration did not complete successfully
1431 }
1432 }
1433
1434 return ok;
1435}

1467template <typename CommType>
1468bool TMC9660<CommType>::GateDriver::configureBreakBeforeMakeTiming_ns(float lowSideUVW_ns,
1469 float highSideUVW_ns,
1470 float lowSideY2_ns,
1471 float highSideY2_ns) noexcept {
1472 // Conversion formula: value = time_ns / 8.33
1473 // Clamp to valid range [0, 255]
1474 constexpr float ns_per_step = 8.33f;
1475
1476 auto convertToRegister = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1477 float value = time_ns / ns_per_step;
1478 // Clamp to valid range
1479 if (value < 0.0f) {
1480 return 0;
1481 }
1482 if (value > 255.0f) {
1483 return 255;
1484 }
1485 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f); // Round to nearest integer
1486 };
1487
1488 uint8_t lowUVW = convertToRegister(lowSideUVW_ns);
1489 uint8_t highUVW = convertToRegister(highSideUVW_ns);
1490 uint8_t lowY2 = convertToRegister(lowSideY2_ns);
1491 uint8_t highY2 = convertToRegister(highSideY2_ns);
1492
1493 return configureBreakBeforeMakeTiming(lowUVW, highUVW, lowY2, highY2);
1494}

1517template <typename CommType>
1518bool TMC9660<CommType>::GateDriver::configureDriveTimes_ns(float sinkTimeUVW_ns, float sourceTimeUVW_ns,
1519 float sinkTimeY2_ns,
1520 float sourceTimeY2_ns) noexcept {
1521 // Conversion formula per TMC9660 documentation:
1522 // t = (1s / 120MHz) × (2 × DRIVE_TIME_xxx + 3)
1523 // Solving for register value: DRIVE_TIME = ((t × 120MHz) - 3) / 2
1524 // Where: 1s / 120MHz = 8.33ns per step
1525 // Formula: value = ((desired_time_ns / 8.33) - 3) / 2
1526 // Clamp to valid range [0, 255]
1527 constexpr float ns_per_step = 8.33f; // 1s / 120MHz
1528
1529 auto convertToRegister = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1530 // Convert nanoseconds to register value using TMC9660 formula:
1531 // t = 8.33ns × (2 × REG + 3) → REG = ((t / 8.33) - 3) / 2
1532 float value = ((time_ns / ns_per_step) - 3.0f) / 2.0f;
1533 // Clamp to valid range [0, 255]
1534 if (value < 0.0f) {
1535 return 0;
1536 }
1537 if (value > 255.0f) {
1538 return 255;
1539 }
1540 // Round to nearest integer (e.g., 10.5 → 11, 10.4 → 10)
1541 // This selects the register value that produces the closest actual time
1542 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f);
1543 };
1544
1545 uint8_t sinkUVW = convertToRegister(sinkTimeUVW_ns);
1546 uint8_t sourceUVW = convertToRegister(sourceTimeUVW_ns);
1547 uint8_t sinkY2 = convertToRegister(sinkTimeY2_ns);
1548 uint8_t sourceY2 = convertToRegister(sourceTimeY2_ns);
1549
1550 return configureDriveTimes(sinkUVW, sourceUVW, sinkY2, sourceY2);
1551}

1768inline float calculateBootstrapCurrent_mA(float gateCharge_nC, float pwmFreq_Hz) noexcept {
1769 constexpr float N_HIGH_SIDE_PHASES = 3.0f; // UVW phases (3 high-side FETs)
1770 constexpr float AVG_DUTY_CYCLE = 0.5f; // Average duty cycle assumption
1771 constexpr float SAFETY_MARGIN = 2.5f; // 2.5x margin for duty peaks and losses
1772
1773 // Average current needed: I = (Qg × N_phases × f_PWM) / duty_cycle
1774 // Convert nC to C, Hz to 1/s: (nC × 1e-9) × N × f_PWM / duty = A
1775 // Then convert to mA and apply safety margin
1776 float chargePerCycle_C = gateCharge_nC * 1e-9f; // Convert nC to C
1777 float avgCurrent_A = (chargePerCycle_C * N_HIGH_SIDE_PHASES * pwmFreq_Hz) / AVG_DUTY_CYCLE;
1778 return avgCurrent_A * 1000.0f * SAFETY_MARGIN; // Convert to mA and apply margin
1779}
1780
1781template <typename CommType>
1782bool TMC9660<CommType>::GateDriver::configurePowerStageProtection(const PowerStageProfile& profile) noexcept {
1783 bool ok = true;
1784 // Y2 SAPs are gated by *both* the per-call profile flag and the per-device capability flag.
1785 // The per-device flag (caps_.y2Phase) is the topology-level "is Y2 wired on this board" answer
1786 // that lets a host-side caller force-skip Y2 once at boot — useful so subsequent careless
1787 // callers can't accidentally re-enable Y2 SAPs on a 3-phase-only board.
1788 const bool cfgY2 = profile.configure_y2_phase && driver.capabilities().y2Phase;
1789
1790 // --- Safety Check: Ensure critical parameters are valid ---
1791 if (profile.busVoltage_V <= 0.0f || profile.pwmFrequency_Hz <= 0.0f ||
1792 profile.expectedPeakCurrent_A <= 0.0f || profile.mosfet_RdsOn_mOhm <= 0.0f ||
1793 profile.shuntResistance_mOhm <= 0.0f || profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC <= 0.0f) {
1794 // Log/Report error: Invalid critical input parameters
1795 return false;
1796 }
1797
1798 // ============================================================================
1799 // PART 0: GATE DRIVER INTERFACE CONFIGURATION
1800 // ============================================================================
1801 // Configure basic hardware interface settings (must be set before timing/protection)
1802
1803 // Step 0.1: Configure PWM output polarity (critical for hardware compatibility)
1804 // Wrong polarity = gate driver won't work correctly with external MOSFET stages
1805 ok &= setOutputPolarity(profile.pwmLowPolarity, profile.pwmHighPolarity);
1806
1807 // ============================================================================
1808 // PART 1: GATE DRIVER TIMING CONFIGURATION
1809 // ============================================================================
1810 // Configure MOSFET switching characteristics based on gate charge (Qg)
1811 // These directly affect switching speed and must be set before protection timing
1812
1813 // Step 1.1: Calculate gate drive times from gate charge
1814 // Target: ~200ns turn-on (source), ~135ns turn-off (sink) for efficiency/safety balance
1815 // With adaptive drive time enabled, these are maximum times; driver optimizes down
1816 // Allow user override via optional profile members for custom switching speed requirements
1817 constexpr float DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_ON_NS = 200.0f; // Default source (turn-on) time target
1818 constexpr float DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_OFF_NS = 135.0f; // Default sink (turn-off) time target
1819
1820 float targetTurnOn_ns = profile.targetTurnOnTime_ns.value_or(DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_ON_NS);
1821 float targetTurnOff_ns = profile.targetTurnOffTime_ns.value_or(DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_OFF_NS);
1822
1823 // Validate override values are positive
1824 if (targetTurnOn_ns <= 0.0f || targetTurnOff_ns <= 0.0f) {
1825 return false; // Invalid override values
1826 }
1827
1828 // Calculate required gate currents: I = Qg / t
1829 // These are theoretical; we'll select closest available enum values
1830 float requiredSourceCurrent_mA = (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC / targetTurnOn_ns) * 1000.0f;
1831 float requiredSinkCurrent_mA = (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC / targetTurnOff_ns) * 1000.0f;
1832
1833 // Select closest available gate current enum values
1834 // Note: Selecting next-higher current results in faster switching (shorter actual rise/fall
1835 // times) This is generally safer (reduces shoot-through risk) but may increase switching losses
1836 // slightly
1837 auto selectSourceCurrent = [](float current_mA) -> tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource {
1838 if (current_mA <= 37.5f)
1839 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_25_MA;
1840 else if (current_mA <= 65.0f)
1841 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_50_MA;
1842 else if (current_mA <= 92.5f)
1843 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_80_MA;
1844 else if (current_mA <= 120.0f)
1845 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_105_MA;
1846 else if (current_mA <= 147.5f)
1847 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_135_MA;
1848 else if (current_mA <= 175.0f)
1849 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_160_MA;
1850 else if (current_mA <= 202.5f)
1851 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_190_MA;
1852 else if (current_mA <= 252.5f)
1853 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_215_MA;
1854 else if (current_mA <= 325.0f)
1855 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_290_MA;
1856 else if (current_mA <= 395.0f)
1857 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_360_MA;
1858 else if (current_mA <= 465.0f)
1859 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_430_MA;
1860 else if (current_mA <= 562.5f)
1861 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_500_MA;
1862 else if (current_mA <= 690.0f)
1863 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_625_MA;
1864 else if (current_mA <= 805.0f)
1865 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_755_MA;
1866 else
1867 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_855_MA;
1868 };
1869
1870 auto selectSinkCurrent = [](float current_mA) -> tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink {
1871 if (current_mA <= 75.0f)
1872 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_50_MA;
1873 else if (current_mA <= 130.0f)
1874 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_100_MA;
1875 else if (current_mA <= 185.0f)
1876 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_160_MA;
1877 else if (current_mA <= 240.0f)
1878 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_210_MA;
1879 else if (current_mA <= 295.0f)
1880 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_270_MA;
1881 else if (current_mA <= 350.0f)
1882 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_320_MA;
1883 else if (current_mA <= 405.0f)
1884 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_380_MA;
1885 else if (current_mA <= 505.0f)
1886 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_430_MA;
1887 else if (current_mA <= 650.0f)
1888 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_580_MA;
1889 else if (current_mA <= 790.0f)
1890 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_720_MA;
1891 else if (current_mA <= 930.0f)
1892 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_860_MA;
1893 else if (current_mA <= 1125.0f)
1894 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1000_MA;
1895 else if (current_mA <= 1380.0f)
1896 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1250_MA;
1897 else if (current_mA <= 1640.0f)
1898 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1510_MA;
1899 else if (current_mA <= 1890.0f)
1900 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1770_MA;
1901 else
1902 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_2000_MA;
1903 };
1904
1905 tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource sourceCurrent = selectSourceCurrent(requiredSourceCurrent_mA);
1906 tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink sinkCurrent = selectSinkCurrent(requiredSinkCurrent_mA);
1907 if (profile.uvw_gate_current_source) {
1908 sourceCurrent = *profile.uvw_gate_current_source;
1909 }
1910 if (profile.uvw_gate_current_sink) {
1911 sinkCurrent = *profile.uvw_gate_current_sink;
1912 }
1913
1914 // Step 1.2: Configure drive times (maximum times with adaptive mode)
1915 // Adaptive drive time will shorten these based on actual gate voltage monitoring
1916 if (cfgY2) {
1917 ok &= configureDriveTimes_ns(targetTurnOff_ns, targetTurnOn_ns, targetTurnOff_ns,
1918 targetTurnOn_ns);
1919 } else {
1920 constexpr float ns_per_step = 8.33f; // 1s / 120MHz
1921 auto convertDriveTimeReg = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1922 float value = ((time_ns / ns_per_step) - 3.0f) / 2.0f;
1923 if (value < 0.0f) {
1924 return 0;
1925 }
1926 if (value > 255.0f) {
1927 return 255;
1928 }
1929 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f);
1930 };
1931 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::DRIVE_TIME_SINK_UVW,
1932 convertDriveTimeReg(targetTurnOff_ns));
1933 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::DRIVE_TIME_SOURCE_UVW,
1934 convertDriveTimeReg(targetTurnOn_ns));
1935 }
1936
1937 // Step 1.3: Enable adaptive drive time for efficiency
1938 // Adaptive mode monitors gate voltage and shortens drive times automatically
1939 if (cfgY2) {
1940 ok &= enableAdaptiveDriveTime(true, true);
1941 } else {
1942 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::USE_ADAPTIVE_DRIVE_TIME_UVW, 1u);
1943 }
1944
1945 // Step 1.4: Configure break-before-make timing (dead time)
1946 // Documentation recommends 0 to let driver use internal optimized timing
1947 // For special cases (high voltage, slow body diodes), dead time can be explicitly set
1948 // Default to 0 per documentation recommendation for optimal performance
1949 // Note: If overrideDeadTime_ns is added to PowerStageProfile in future, use:
1950 // float dead_time_ns = profile.overrideDeadTime_ns.value_or(0.0f);
1951 constexpr float dead_time_ns = 0.0f;
1952 if (cfgY2) {
1953 ok &= configureBreakBeforeMakeTiming_ns(dead_time_ns, dead_time_ns, dead_time_ns, dead_time_ns);
1954 } else {
1955 constexpr float ns_per_step_bbm = 8.33f;
1956 auto convertBbmReg = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1957 float value = time_ns / ns_per_step_bbm;
1958 if (value < 0.0f) {
1959 return 0;
1960 }
1961 if (value > 255.0f) {
1962 return 255;
1963 }
1964 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f);
1965 };
1966 const uint8_t bbm = convertBbmReg(dead_time_ns);
1967 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_LOW_UVW, bbm);
1968 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_HIGH_UVW, bbm);
1969 }
1970
1971 // Gate currents (SAP 245–246): program after drive times / BBM per TMC9660 gate-driver ordering.
1972 //
1973 // FW051V100 silicon-rev-1/var-2 quirk: NR 245 (UVW_SINK_CURRENT) and NR 246
1974 // (UVW_SOURCE_CURRENT) reject every plain enum value (0..15) with REPLY_INVALID_VALUE —
1975 // both the auto-derived index AND the chip's own reset-default index — unless the host
1976 // writes the nibble-replicated form 0x111 * enum_idx, i.e. the same 4-bit code placed in
1977 // each of the three low nibbles (bits [11:8], [7:4], [3:0]). 0x111 = 0b_0001_0001_0001,
1978 // so multiplying by enum_idx ∈ [0,15] gives 0x000, 0x111, 0x222, …, 0xFFF — the full
1979 // 16-value range fits losslessly in 12 bits because each nibble independently carries
1980 // the 4-bit code. The firmware appears to decode the 12-bit word as three independent
1981 // 4-bit fields (likely one per gate-driver leg) and only accepts writes where all three
1982 // fields agree. Empirically: writing 0x444 stores 4 and GAP echoes back 4; writing plain
1983 // 4 (= 0x004, three disagreeing nibbles) returns INVALID_VALUE. Other gate-current-
1984 // related NRs (239 USE_ADAPTIVE_DRIVE_TIME_UVW, 241/242 DRIVE_TIME_*_UVW) accept the
1985 // plain form, so this is specifically a 245/246 (and by extension 247/248 Y2)
1986 // marshalling quirk on this firmware revision.
1987 //
1988 // The transform is applied unconditionally on the assumption it's harmless on
1989 // future/other firmware revisions (the chip would still see enum_idx in the low nibble).
1990 // If a future silicon rev rejects the replicated form, this can be gated via a runtime
1991 // capability flag without touching call sites.
1992 auto encodeGateCurrent = [](uint32_t enum_idx) noexcept -> uint32_t {
1993 return 0x111u * (enum_idx & 0xFu);
1994 };
1995 if (profile.program_gate_current_limits) {
1996 if (cfgY2) {
1997 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SINK_CURRENT,
1998 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sinkCurrent)));
1999 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SOURCE_CURRENT,
2000 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sourceCurrent)));
2001 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::Y2_SINK_CURRENT,
2002 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sinkCurrent)));
2003 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::Y2_SOURCE_CURRENT,
2004 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sourceCurrent)));
2005 } else {
2006 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SINK_CURRENT,
2007 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sinkCurrent)));
2008 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SOURCE_CURRENT,
2009 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sourceCurrent)));
2010 }
2011 }
2012
2013 // Step 1.5: Configure bootstrap current limit
2014 // Bootstrap must supply gate charge for high-side FETs at PWM switching rate
2015 // Uses physics-based calculation (see calculateBootstrapCurrent_mA helper function)
2016 tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit bootstrapCurrent;
2017 float bootstrapCurrent_mA =
2018 calculateBootstrapCurrent_mA(profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC, profile.pwmFrequency_Hz);
2019
2020 if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 68.0f) {
2021 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_45_MA;
2022 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 116.0f) {
2023 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_91_MA;
2024 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 166.0f) {
2025 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_141_MA;
2026 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 229.0f) {
2027 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_191_MA;
2028 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 279.5f) {
2029 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_267_MA;
2030 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 316.5f) {
2031 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_292_MA;
2032 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 366.0f) {
2033 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_341_MA;
2034 } else {
2035 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_391_MA;
2036 }
2037
2038 ok &= configureBootstrapCurrentLimit(bootstrapCurrent);
2039
2040 // Step 1.6: Configure undervoltage protection (supply, VDRV, and bootstrap)
2041 // Supply level: Configured from profile (0=disabled, 1-16 map to HW levels 0-15)
2042 // VDRV protection: Enabled by default for safety
2043 // Bootstrap UVP: Enabled by default for safety (prevents gate drive failure from insufficient
2044 // bootstrap voltage)
2045 if (cfgY2) {
2046 ok &= configureUndervoltageProtection(
2047 profile.supplyLevel, // Supply level from profile
2048 tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED, // VDRV protection (keep enabled)
2049 tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED, // Bootstrap UVW (keep enabled for safety)
2050 tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED); // Bootstrap Y2 (keep enabled for safety)
2051 } else {
2052 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SUPPLY_LEVEL,
2053 static_cast<uint32_t>(profile.supplyLevel));
2054 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::VDRV_ENABLE,
2055 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED));
2056 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::BST_UVW_ENABLE,
2057 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED));
2058 }
2059
2060 // ============================================================================
2061 // PART 2: PROTECTION PARAMETER CONFIGURATION
2062 // ============================================================================
2063
2064 if (profile.configure_gate_oc_vgs_protection) {
2065
2066 // Step 2.1: Estimate di/dt (current rise rate during switching)
2067 // di/dt ≈ V_bus / L_motor
2068 // Use worst-case low inductance for safety (higher di/dt → longer blanking needed)
2069 float di_dt_A_per_us;
2070 if (std::isnan(profile.motorInductance_uH) || profile.motorInductance_uH <= 0.0f) {
2071 // Conservative worst-case: assume low inductance (20 µH) for noisy motors
2072 // Note: Gear motors typically have higher inductance (50-100+ µH), but using
2073 // lower value ensures safer (longer) blanking time for worst-case scenarios
2074 constexpr float L_WORST_CASE_uH = 20.0f; // Fixed: was 50.0f, now matches comment
2075 di_dt_A_per_us = profile.busVoltage_V / L_WORST_CASE_uH;
2076 } else {
2077 di_dt_A_per_us = profile.busVoltage_V / profile.motorInductance_uH;
2078 }
2079
2080 // Step 2.2: Select overcurrent blanking time based on di/dt
2081 // Higher di/dt → longer blanking needed to ignore switching spikes
2082 // Apply blankingMargin safety factor to the base time
2083 float baseBlankingTime_us;
2084 if (di_dt_A_per_us < 5.0f) {
2085 baseBlankingTime_us = 0.25f;
2086 } else if (di_dt_A_per_us < 15.0f) {
2087 baseBlankingTime_us = 0.5f;
2088 } else if (di_dt_A_per_us < 30.0f) {
2089 baseBlankingTime_us = 1.0f;
2090 } else if (di_dt_A_per_us < 60.0f) {
2091 baseBlankingTime_us = 2.0f;
2092 } else {
2093 // Very high di/dt - use longer blanking, but cap at PWM period limit
2094 float pwmPeriod_us = 1000000.0f / profile.pwmFrequency_Hz;
2095 // Cap blanking at 15% of PWM period for normal frequencies
2096 // For very high frequencies (>100kHz), use more conservative 10% cap
2097 float maxBlankingRatio = (profile.pwmFrequency_Hz > 100000.0f) ? 0.10f : 0.15f;
2098 baseBlankingTime_us = pwmPeriod_us * maxBlankingRatio;
2099 // Ensure minimum blanking time scales with PWM period but has absolute floor
2100 // At very high frequencies, use 5% of period or 0.25µs minimum (whichever is larger)
2101 float minBlanking_us = std::max(0.25f, pwmPeriod_us * 0.05f);
2102 if (baseBlankingTime_us < minBlanking_us) {
2103 baseBlankingTime_us = minBlanking_us;
2104 }
2105 }
2106
2107 // Apply safety margin
2108 float targetBlankingTime_us = baseBlankingTime_us * profile.blankingMargin;
2109
2110 // Map to discrete register values (select next higher value for safety)
2111 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming ocBlanking;
2112 if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 0.25f) {
2113 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_25_MICROSEC;
2114 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 0.5f) {
2115 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2116 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 1.0f) {
2117 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_1_MICROSEC;
2118 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 2.0f) {
2119 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_2_MICROSEC;
2120 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 4.0f) {
2121 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_4_MICROSEC;
2122 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 6.0f) {
2123 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_6_MICROSEC;
2124 } else {
2125 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_8_MICROSEC;
2126 }
2127
2128 // Step 2.3: Select deglitch time based on gate charge (Qg)
2129 // Low Qg = fast switching = more noise = longer deglitch needed
2130 // High Qg = slow switching = less noise = shorter deglitch OK
2131 // Apply blankingMargin safety factor
2132 float baseDeglitchTime_us;
2133 if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 15.0f) {
2134 // Fast FETs (GaN, low Qg) - need longer deglitch for noise filtering
2135 baseDeglitchTime_us = 2.0f;
2136 } else if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 40.0f) {
2137 // Normal FETs - moderate deglitch
2138 baseDeglitchTime_us = 1.0f;
2139 } else {
2140 // Slow FETs (high Qg) - shorter deglitch sufficient
2141 baseDeglitchTime_us = 0.5f;
2142 }
2143
2144 // Apply safety margin
2145 float targetDeglitchTime_us = baseDeglitchTime_us * profile.blankingMargin;
2146
2147 // Map to discrete register values (select next higher value for safety)
2148 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming ocDeglitch;
2149 if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 0.25f) {
2150 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_25_MICROSEC;
2151 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 0.5f) {
2152 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2153 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 1.0f) {
2154 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_1_MICROSEC;
2155 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 2.0f) {
2156 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_2_MICROSEC;
2157 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 4.0f) {
2158 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_4_MICROSEC;
2159 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 6.0f) {
2160 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_6_MICROSEC;
2161 } else {
2162 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_8_MICROSEC;
2163 }
2164
2165 // Step 2.4: Select VGS short protection blanking/deglitch based on gate charge
2166 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime vgsBlanking;
2167 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime vgsDeglitch;
2168 if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 15.0f) {
2169 // Fast FETs - longer blanking/deglitch
2170 vgsBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2171 vgsDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime::T_2_MICROSEC;
2172 } else if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 40.0f) {
2173 // Normal FETs
2174 vgsBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2175 vgsDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime::T_1_MICROSEC;
2176 } else {
2177 // Slow FETs - shorter times
2178 vgsBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime::T_0_25_MICROSEC;
2179 vgsDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2180 }
2181
2182 // Step 2.5: Calculate overcurrent thresholds
2183 // TMC9660 uses dual sensing: RSHUNT for low-side (primary), VDS for high-side (always)
2184 // Low-side can optionally use VDS if Rds_on is low enough
2185 // Calculate separate thresholds for each sensing method
2186
2187 // RSHUNT threshold (for low-side when VDS disabled)
2188 // Threshold voltage = I_peak * margin * R_shunt
2189 float rshuntThreshold_mV =
2190 profile.expectedPeakCurrent_A * profile.overcurrentMargin * profile.shuntResistance_mOhm;
2191
2192 // VDS threshold (for high-side always, and low-side if VDS enabled)
2193 // Threshold voltage = I_peak * margin * Rds_on
2194 float vdsThreshold_mV =
2195 profile.expectedPeakCurrent_A * profile.overcurrentMargin * profile.mosfet_RdsOn_mOhm;
2196
2197 // Helper function to select threshold register value
2198 auto selectThreshold = [](float voltage_mV, bool isVds) -> tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold {
2199 // For VDS: use VDS values (lower); For RSHUNT: use RSHUNT values (higher)
2200 // Select smallest threshold >= calculated value for safety
2201 if (isVds) {
2202 // VDS threshold values
2203 if (voltage_mV <= 63.0f) {
2204 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_80_OR_63_MILLIVOLT; // 63mV VDS
2205 } else if (voltage_mV <= 125.0f) {
2206 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_165_OR_125_MILLIVOLT; // 125mV VDS
2207 } else if (voltage_mV <= 187.0f) {
2208 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_250_OR_187_MILLIVOLT; // 187mV VDS
2209 } else if (voltage_mV <= 248.0f) {
2210 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_330_OR_248_MILLIVOLT; // 248mV VDS
2211 } else if (voltage_mV <= 312.0f) {
2212 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_415_OR_312_MILLIVOLT; // 312mV VDS
2213 } else if (voltage_mV <= 374.0f) {
2214 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_500_OR_374_MILLIVOLT; // 374mV VDS
2215 } else if (voltage_mV <= 434.0f) {
2216 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_582_OR_434_MILLIVOLT; // 434mV VDS
2217 } else if (voltage_mV <= 504.0f) {
2218 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_660_OR_504_MILLIVOLT; // 504mV VDS
2219 } else if (voltage_mV <= 705.0f) {
2220 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_125_OR_705_MILLIVOLT; // 705mV VDS
2221 } else if (voltage_mV <= 940.0f) {
2222 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_250_OR_940_MILLIVOLT; // 940mV VDS
2223 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1180.0f) {
2224 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_375_OR_1180_MILLIVOLT; // 1180mV VDS
2225 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1410.0f) {
2226 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_500_OR_1410_MILLIVOLT; // 1410mV VDS
2227 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1650.0f) {
2228 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_625_OR_1650_MILLIVOLT; // 1650mV VDS
2229 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1880.0f) {
2230 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_750_OR_1880_MILLIVOLT; // 1880mV VDS
2231 } else if (voltage_mV <= 2110.0f) {
2232 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_875_OR_2110_MILLIVOLT; // 2110mV VDS
2233 } else {
2234 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_1000_OR_2350_MILLIVOLT; // 2350mV VDS (max)
2235 }
2236 } else {
2237 // RSHUNT threshold values (higher than VDS for same current)
2238 // Hardware automatically selects RSHUNT value when VDS is disabled for low-side
2239 if (voltage_mV <= 80.0f) {
2240 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_80_OR_63_MILLIVOLT; // 80mV RSHUNT
2241 } else if (voltage_mV <= 125.0f) {
2242 // Special case: V_125_OR_705 provides 125mV RSHUNT (maps to 705mV VDS for high-side)
2243 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_125_OR_705_MILLIVOLT;
2244 } else if (voltage_mV <= 165.0f) {
2245 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_165_OR_125_MILLIVOLT; // 165mV RSHUNT
2246 } else if (voltage_mV <= 250.0f) {
2247 // V_250_OR_187 provides 250mV RSHUNT (normal case)
2248 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_250_OR_187_MILLIVOLT;
2249 } else if (voltage_mV <= 330.0f) {
2250 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_330_OR_248_MILLIVOLT; // 330mV RSHUNT
2251 } else if (voltage_mV <= 375.0f) {
2252 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_375_OR_1180_MILLIVOLT; // 375mV RSHUNT
2253 } else if (voltage_mV <= 415.0f) {
2254 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_415_OR_312_MILLIVOLT; // 415mV RSHUNT
2255 } else if (voltage_mV <= 500.0f) {
2256 // V_500_OR_374 provides 500mV RSHUNT (normal case)
2257 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_500_OR_374_MILLIVOLT;
2258 } else if (voltage_mV <= 582.0f) {
2259 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_582_OR_434_MILLIVOLT; // 582mV RSHUNT
2260 } else if (voltage_mV <= 625.0f) {
2261 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_625_OR_1650_MILLIVOLT; // 625mV RSHUNT
2262 } else if (voltage_mV <= 660.0f) {
2263 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_660_OR_504_MILLIVOLT; // 660mV RSHUNT
2264 } else if (voltage_mV <= 750.0f) {
2265 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_750_OR_1880_MILLIVOLT; // 750mV RSHUNT
2266 } else if (voltage_mV <= 875.0f) {
2267 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_875_OR_2110_MILLIVOLT; // 875mV RSHUNT
2268 } else {
2269 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_1000_OR_2350_MILLIVOLT; // 1000mV RSHUNT (max)
2270 }
2271 }
2272 };
2273
2274 // Step 2.6: Determine if VDS should be used for low-side
2275 // VDS sensing is reliable when Rds_on is very low (< 10 mΩ) and for low bus voltages
2276 // For high-performance drives, RSHUNT is typically preferred for low-side
2277 bool useVdsLowSide = (profile.mosfet_RdsOn_mOhm < 10.0f);
2278
2279 // Select appropriate thresholds
2280 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold ocThresholdLowSide =
2281 useVdsLowSide ? selectThreshold(vdsThreshold_mV, true) // Use VDS threshold
2282 : selectThreshold(rshuntThreshold_mV, false); // Use RSHUNT threshold
2283 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold ocThresholdHighSide =
2284 selectThreshold(vdsThreshold_mV, true); // Always VDS
2285
2286 // Step 2.7: Configure all protection parameters
2287 // 2.7.1: Enable overcurrent protection
2288 if (cfgY2) {
2289 ok &= enableOvercurrentProtection(tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED, // UVW low side
2290 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED, // UVW high side
2291 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED, // Y2 low side
2292 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED); // Y2 high side
2293 } else {
2294 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE,
2295 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED));
2296 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE,
2297 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED));
2298 }
2299
2300 // 2.7.2: Set overcurrent thresholds (separate for low-side and high-side)
2301 if (cfgY2) {
2302 ok &= setOvercurrentThresholds(
2303 ocThresholdLowSide, // UVW low side (RSHUNT or VDS based on useVdsLowSide)
2304 ocThresholdHighSide, // UVW high side (always VDS)
2305 ocThresholdLowSide, // Y2 low side (RSHUNT or VDS based on useVdsLowSide)
2306 ocThresholdHighSide); // Y2 high side (always VDS)
2307 } else {
2308 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_THRESHOLD,
2309 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocThresholdLowSide));
2310 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_THRESHOLD,
2311 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocThresholdHighSide));
2312 }
2313
2314 // 2.7.3: Set overcurrent blanking times
2315 if (cfgY2) {
2316 ok &= setOvercurrentBlanking(ocBlanking, // UVW low side
2317 ocBlanking, // UVW high side
2318 ocBlanking, // Y2 low side
2319 ocBlanking); // Y2 high side
2320 } else {
2321 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_BLANKING,
2322 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocBlanking));
2323 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_BLANKING,
2324 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocBlanking));
2325 }
2326
2327 // 2.7.4: Set overcurrent deglitch times
2328 if (cfgY2) {
2329 ok &= setOvercurrentDeglitch(ocDeglitch, // UVW low side
2330 ocDeglitch, // UVW high side
2331 ocDeglitch, // Y2 low side
2332 ocDeglitch); // Y2 high side
2333 } else {
2334 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_DEGLITCH,
2335 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocDeglitch));
2336 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_DEGLITCH,
2337 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocDeglitch));
2338 }
2339
2340 // 2.7.5: Enable/disable VDS monitoring for low-side
2341 if (cfgY2) {
2342 ok &= enableVdsMonitoringLow(
2343 useVdsLowSide ? tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::ENABLED : tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::DISABLED, // UVW
2344 useVdsLowSide ? tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::ENABLED : tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::DISABLED); // Y2
2345 } else {
2346 ok &= driver.writeParameter(
2347 tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_USE_VDS,
2348 static_cast<uint32_t>(useVdsLowSide ? tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::ENABLED
2349 : tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::DISABLED));
2350 }
2351
2352 // 2.7.6: Enable VGS short protection (all transitions)
2353 ok &= configureVgsShortProtectionUVW(tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side ON
2354 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side OFF
2355 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // High side ON
2356 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED); // High side OFF
2357
2358 if (cfgY2) {
2359 ok &= configureVgsShortProtectionY2(tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side ON
2360 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side OFF
2361 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // High side ON
2362 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED); // High side OFF
2363 }
2364
2365 // 2.7.7: Set VGS short blanking and deglitch times
2366 if (cfgY2) {
2367 ok &= setVgsShortBlankingTime(vgsBlanking, vgsBlanking); // UVW, Y2
2368 ok &= setVgsShortDeglitchTime(vgsDeglitch, vgsDeglitch); // UVW, Y2
2369 } else {
2370 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_BLANKING,
2371 static_cast<uint32_t>(vgsBlanking));
2372 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_DEGLITCH,
2373 static_cast<uint32_t>(vgsDeglitch));
2374 }
2375
2376 // ============================================================================
2377 // PART 3: FAULT HANDLING CONFIGURATION
2378 // ============================================================================
2379
2380 // Step 3.1: Configure retry behavior after gate driver fault
2381 ok &= setRetryBehavior(profile.retryBehaviour);
2382
2383 // Step 3.2: Configure drive fault behavior after all retries fail
2384 ok &= setDriveFaultBehavior(profile.faultBehaviour);
2385
2386 // Step 3.3: Set maximum number of fault handler retries
2387 ok &= setFaultHandlerRetries(profile.faultHandlerRetries);
2388
2389 } // configure_gate_oc_vgs_protection
2390
2391 return ok;
2392}

2402template <typename CommType>
2403bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureHall(tmc9660::tmcl::HallSectorOffset sectorOffset,
2404 tmc9660::tmcl::Direction inverted,
2405 tmc9660::tmcl::EnableDisable enableExtrapolation,
2406 uint8_t filterLength) noexcept {
2407 bool ok = true;
2408 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::HALL_SECTOR_OFFSET,
2409 static_cast<uint32_t>(sectorOffset));
2410 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::HALL_INVERT_DIRECTION,
2411 static_cast<uint32_t>(inverted));
2412 ok &=
2413 driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::HALL_EXTRAPOLATION_ENABLE,
2414 enableExtrapolation == tmc9660::tmcl::EnableDisable::ENABLED ? 1u : 0u);
2415 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::HALL_FILTER_LENGTH,
2416 static_cast<uint32_t>(filterLength));
2417 return ok;
2418}

2467template <typename CommType>
2468int16_t TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::degreesToHallOffset(float degrees) noexcept {
2469 // Convert degrees to 16-bit signed integer representation
2470 // Formula: value = (degrees * 65536) / 360
2471 // This maps 360° to the full 16-bit range (-32768 to 32767)
2472 constexpr float DEGREES_TO_UNITS = 65536.0f / 360.0f;
2473 float value = degrees * DEGREES_TO_UNITS;
2474
2475 // Round to nearest integer
2476 int32_t intValue = static_cast<int32_t>(value + (value >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f));
2477
2478 // Wrap around to stay within 16-bit signed integer range [-32768, 32767]
2479 // This handles angles > 360° or < -360° by normalizing using modulo arithmetic
2480 constexpr int32_t RANGE = 65536;
2481 intValue %= RANGE;
2482 // Normalize negative modulo results to positive range [0, 65535]
2483 if (intValue < 0) {
2484 intValue += RANGE;
2485 }
2486 // Convert values in [32768, 65535] to negative range [-32768, -1]
2487 if (intValue > 32767) {
2488 intValue -= RANGE;
2489 }
2490
2491 return static_cast<int16_t>(intValue);
2492}
2493
2494template <typename CommType>
2495int16_t TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::radiansToHallOffset(float radians) noexcept {
2496 // Convert radians to 16-bit signed integer representation
2497 // Formula: value = (radians * 65536) / (2 * π)
2498 // This maps 2π radians to the full 16-bit range (-32768 to 32767)
2499 constexpr float RADIANS_TO_UNITS = 65536.0f / (2.0f * 3.14159265358979323846f);
2500 float value = radians * RADIANS_TO_UNITS;
2501
2502 // Round to nearest integer
2503 int32_t intValue = static_cast<int32_t>(value + (value >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f));
2504
2505 // Wrap around to stay within 16-bit signed integer range [-32768, 32767]
2506 // This handles angles > 2π or < -2π by normalizing using modulo arithmetic
2507 constexpr int32_t RANGE = 65536;
2508 intValue %= RANGE;
2509 // Normalize negative modulo results to positive range [0, 65535]
2510 if (intValue < 0) {
2511 intValue += RANGE;
2512 }
2513 // Convert values in [32768, 65535] to negative range [-32768, -1]
2514 if (intValue > 32767) {
2515 intValue -= RANGE;
2516 }
2517
2518 return static_cast<int16_t>(intValue);
2519}

2683template <typename CommType>
2684bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::setSPIEncoderRequestData(const uint8_t* requestData,
2685 uint8_t size) noexcept {
2686 if (size == 0 || size > 16)
2687 return false;
2688 uint32_t w0 = 0, w1 = 0, w2 = 0, w3 = 0;
2689 for (uint8_t i = 0; i < size && i < 16; ++i) {
2690 uint32_t val = static_cast<uint32_t>(requestData[i]) & 0xFFu;
2691 if (i < 4)
2692 w0 |= val << (8 * i);
2693 else if (i < 8)
2694 w1 |= val << (8 * (i - 4));
2695 else if (i < 12)
2696 w2 |= val << (8 * (i - 8));
2697 else
2698 w3 |= val << (8 * (i - 12));
2699 }
2700 bool ok = true;
2701 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_3_0, w0);
2702 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_7_4, w1);
2703 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_11_8, w2);
2704 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_15_12, w3);
2705 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_MAIN_TRANSFER_CMD_SIZE, size);
2706 return ok;
2707}
