2854// Auto-Configuration Functions
2855// –––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
2856
2857template <typename CommType>
2858bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const HallConfig& config) noexcept {
2859 bool ok = true;
2860
2861 // Step 1: Configure basic Hall sensor settings
2862 ok &= configureHall(config.sectorOffset, config.direction, config.extrapolation,
2863 config.filterLength);
2864
2865 // Step 2: Set position offsets if provided
2866 if (config.offset0Deg.has_value() || config.offset60Deg.has_value() ||
2867 config.offset120Deg.has_value() || config.offset180Deg.has_value() ||
2868 config.offset240Deg.has_value() || config.offset300Deg.has_value() ||
2869 config.globalOffsetDeg.has_value()) {
2870 // Use provided values or defaults
2871 float offset0 = config.offset0Deg.value_or(0.0f);
2872 float offset60 = config.offset60Deg.value_or(60.0f);
2873 float offset120 = config.offset120Deg.value_or(120.0f);
2874 float offset180 = config.offset180Deg.value_or(180.0f);
2875 float offset240 = config.offset240Deg.value_or(240.0f);
2876 float offset300 = config.offset300Deg.value_or(300.0f);
2877 float globalOffset = config.globalOffsetDeg.value_or(0.0f);
2878
2879 ok &= setHallPositionOffsetsDegrees(offset0, offset60, offset120, offset180, offset240,
2880 offset300, globalOffset);
2881 }
2882
2883 return ok;
2884}
2885
2886template <typename CommType>
2887bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const AbnConfig& config) noexcept {
2888 bool ok = true;
2889
2890 // Step 1: Configure ABN encoder basic settings
2891 ok &= configureABNEncoder(config.countsPerRev, config.direction, config.nChannelInverted);
2892
2893 // Step 2: Configure ABN initialization method
2894 ok &= configureABNInitialization(config.initMethod, config.initDelay, config.initVelocity,
2895 config.nChannelOffset);
2896
2897 // Step 3: Configure N-channel filtering
2898 ok &= configureABNNChannel(config.nChannelFiltering, config.clearOnNextNull);
2899
2900 // Step 4: For FORCED_PHI_E_* init methods, optionally set OPENLOOP_CURRENT
2901 // (param 46, mA). The datasheet (param-mode line 2411-2422) specifies that
2902 // this current — not OPENLOOP_VOLTAGE — is what physically drives the rotor
2903 // to a known electrical angle during alignment. We only write it when the
2904 // caller explicitly opts in (initOpenloopCurrent_mA != 0) so that callers
2905 // using USE_HALL / USE_N_CHANNEL_OFFSET / USE_OFFSET (no alignment current
2906 // needed) and callers who already set OPENLOOP_CURRENT elsewhere are
2907 // unaffected.
2908 const bool needsAlignmentCurrent =
2909 (config.initMethod == tmc9660::tmcl::AbnInitMethod::FORCED_PHI_E_ZERO_WITH_ACTIVE_SWING) ||
2910 (config.initMethod == tmc9660::tmcl::AbnInitMethod::FORCED_PHI_E_90_ZERO);
2911 if (needsAlignmentCurrent && config.initOpenloopCurrent_mA != 0) {
2912 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::OPENLOOP_CURRENT,
2913 static_cast<uint32_t>(config.initOpenloopCurrent_mA));
2914 }
2915
2916 return ok;
2917}
2918
2919template <typename CommType>
2920bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const Abn2Config& config) noexcept {
2921 bool ok = true;
2922
2923 // Configure secondary ABN encoder
2924 ok &= configureSecondaryABNEncoder(config.countsPerRev, config.direction, config.gearRatio);
2925
2926 // Enable or disable the encoder
2927 ok &= setSecondaryABNEncoderEnabled(config.enable);
2928
2929 return ok;
2930}
2931
2932template <typename CommType>
2933bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const SpiEncoderConfig& config) noexcept {
2934 // Capability gate: SPI encoder must be enabled in the bootloader (so the chip muxes the
2935 // CS / SCK / MISO pins to the SPI-encoder block). When disabled, every SPI-encoder NR
2936 // (181..201) returns REPLY_CMD_NOT_AVAILABLE — surface that as a single clear host-side
2937 // ERROR before issuing 5+ doomed SAPs.
2938 if (!driver.capabilities().spiEncoder) {
2939 driver.comm().logDebug(
2940 0, "TMC9660",
2941 "FeedbackSense::configureAuto(SpiEncoder): subsystem disabled — set "
2942 "BootloaderConfig.spiEnc.enable=true (and re-run bootloader) to use SPI encoder.");
2943 return false;
2944 }
2945
2946 bool ok = true;
2947
2948 // Step 1: Configure SPI encoder timing and frame size
2949 ok &= configureSPIEncoder(config.cmdSize, config.csSettleTimeNs, config.csIdleTimeUs);
2950
2951 // Step 2: Configure SPI encoder data format
2952 ok &= configureSPIEncoderDataFormat(config.positionMask, config.positionShift, config.direction);
2953
2954 // Step 3: Set request data for continuous transfer mode if provided
2955 if (config.requestData.has_value()) {
2956 ok &= setSPIEncoderRequestData(config.requestData->data(), config.cmdSize);
2957
2958 // Enable continuous transfer mode
2959 ok &= driver.writeParameter(
2960 tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER,
2961 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::SpiEncoderTransfer::CONTINUOUS_POSITION_COUNTER_READ));
2962 }
2963
2964 // Step 4: Configure SPI encoder initialization
2965 ok &= configureSPIEncoderInitialization(config.initMethod, config.offset);
2966
2967 // Step 5: Configure LUT correction if enabled
2968 if (config.lutCorrection == tmc9660::tmcl::EnableDisable::ENABLED) {
2969 ok &= setSPIEncoderLUTCorrection(config.lutCorrection, config.lutShiftFactor);
2970 }
2971
2972 return ok;
2973}

3116//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3117// Auto-Configuration
3118//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3119
3120template <typename CommType>
3121bool TMC9660<CommType>::TorqueFluxControl::configureAuto(const TorqueFluxConfig& config) noexcept {
3122 bool ok = true;
3123
3124 // Step 1: Calculate or use provided PI gains
3125 uint16_t torqueP, torqueI;
3126 uint16_t fluxP, fluxI;
3127
3128 if (config.torqueP.has_value() && config.torqueI.has_value()) {
3129 // User provided direct PI gains - use them
3130 torqueP = config.torqueP.value();
3131 torqueI = config.torqueI.value();
3132 } else {
3133 // No direct gains provided - use defaults
3134 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_P = 50;
3135 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I = 100;
3136 torqueP = DEFAULT_P;
3137 torqueI = DEFAULT_I;
3138 }
3139
3140 // Flux gains: use provided values, or default to torque gains
3141 if (config.separateTorqueFluxLoops) {
3142 if (config.fluxP.has_value() && config.fluxI.has_value()) {
3143 fluxP = config.fluxP.value();
3144 fluxI = config.fluxI.value();
3145 } else {
3146 // Default flux gains to torque gains
3147 fluxP = torqueP;
3148 fluxI = torqueI;
3149 }
3150 } else {
3151 // Not used when loops are combined, but initialize anyway
3152 fluxP = torqueP;
3153 fluxI = torqueI;
3154 }
3155
3156 // Step 2: Configure torque/flux loop separation and PI gains
3157 if (config.separateTorqueFluxLoops) {
3158 ok &=
3159 setTorqueFluxPiSeparation(tmc9660::tmcl::TorqueFluxPiSeparation::TORQUE_FLUX_PI_SEPARATED);
3160 ok &= setCurrentLoopGains(torqueP, torqueI, true, fluxP, fluxI);
3161 } else {
3162 ok &= setTorqueFluxPiSeparation(tmc9660::tmcl::TorqueFluxPiSeparation::TORQUE_FLUX_PI_COMBINED);
3163 ok &= setCurrentLoopGains(torqueP, torqueI, false);
3164 }
3165
3166 // Step 3: Configure normalization (use provided values or defaults)
3167 // Default: SHIFT_8_BIT for P (good balance), SHIFT_16_BIT for I (better precision)
3168 // These defaults match the datasheet defaults and work well for most motors.
3169 tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization pNorm =
3170 config.pNormalization.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization::SHIFT_8_BIT);
3171 tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization iNorm =
3172 config.iNormalization.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization::SHIFT_16_BIT);
3173 ok &= setCurrentNormalization(pNorm, iNorm);
3174
3175 // Step 4: Configure offsets
3176 ok &= setTorqueOffset(config.torqueOffset_mA);
3177 ok &= setFluxOffset(config.fluxOffset_mA);
3178
3179 // Step 5: Configure field weakening if enabled
3180 if (config.enableFieldWeakening) {
3181 ok &= setFieldWeakeningI(config.fieldWeakeningI);
3182
3183 // Convert percentage threshold to register value
3184 // Read current OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT to calculate threshold
3185 uint16_t outputVoltageLimit;
3186 if (driver.motorConfig.getOutputVoltageLimit(outputVoltageLimit)) {
3187 // Calculate threshold as percentage of OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT
3188 float thresholdValue =
3189 static_cast<float>(outputVoltageLimit) * config.fieldWeakeningVoltageThresholdPercent;
3190 uint16_t thresholdRegister = static_cast<uint16_t>(thresholdValue + 0.5f);
3191
3192 // Clamp to valid range [0-32767]
3193 if (thresholdRegister > 32767)
3194 thresholdRegister = 32767;
3195
3196 ok &= setFieldWeakeningVoltageThreshold(thresholdRegister);
3197 } else {
3198 // Fallback: use percentage of default OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT (8000)
3199 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT = 8000;
3200 float thresholdValue = static_cast<float>(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT) *
3201 config.fieldWeakeningVoltageThresholdPercent;
3202 uint16_t thresholdRegister = static_cast<uint16_t>(thresholdValue + 0.5f);
3203 ok &= setFieldWeakeningVoltageThreshold(thresholdRegister);
3204 }
3205 }
3206
3207 // Step 6: Configure torque biquad filter if enabled
3208 if (config.enableTorqueBiquadFilter) {
3209 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterEnable(true);
3210
3211 // Configure biquad filter coefficients if provided
3212 // Note: Coefficients are in Q4.20 format (24-bit, 4 integer + 20 fractional bits)
3213 // Default values if not provided: BCOEFF_0 = 1048576 (1.0), others = 0
3214 if (config.biquadACoeff1.has_value()) {
3215 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterACoeff1(config.biquadACoeff1.value());
3216 }
3217 if (config.biquadACoeff2.has_value()) {
3218 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterACoeff2(config.biquadACoeff2.value());
3219 }
3220 if (config.biquadBCoeff0.has_value()) {
3221 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterBCoeff0(config.biquadBCoeff0.value());
3222 }
3223 if (config.biquadBCoeff1.has_value()) {
3224 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterBCoeff1(config.biquadBCoeff1.value());
3225 }
3226 if (config.biquadBCoeff2.has_value()) {
3227 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterBCoeff2(config.biquadBCoeff2.value());
3228 }
3229 // If coefficients are not provided, filter uses hardware defaults:
3230 // BCOEFF_0 = 1048576 (1.0 in Q4.20), all others = 0 (pass-through)
3231 }
3232
3233 return ok;
3234}

3453//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3454// Auto-Configuration
3455//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3456
3457template <typename CommType>
3458bool TMC9660<CommType>::VelocityControl::configureAuto(const VelocityConfig& config) noexcept {
3459 bool ok = true;
3460
3461 // Step 1: Configure velocity sensor selection
3462 ok &= setVelocitySensor(config.sensorSelection);
3463
3464 // Step 2: Configure PI gains (use provided values or defaults)
3465 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_P = 800; // Default P gain (typical for velocity control)
3466 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I = 1; // Default I gain (typical for velocity control)
3467
3468 uint16_t velocityP = config.velocityP.value_or(DEFAULT_P);
3469 uint16_t velocityI = config.velocityI.value_or(DEFAULT_I);
3470
3471 // Clamp to valid range [0-32767]
3472 if (velocityP > 32767)
3473 velocityP = 32767;
3474 if (velocityI > 32767)
3475 velocityI = 32767;
3476 if (velocityI < 1)
3477 velocityI = 1; // Minimum I gain
3478
3479 ok &= setVelocityLoopGains(velocityP, velocityI);
3480
3481 // Step 3: Configure normalization
3482 ok &= setVelocityNormalization(config.pNormalization, config.iNormalization);
3483
3484 // Step 4: Configure velocity scaling factor
3485 // Formula from datasheet: k_RPM = (CPR × 2^24) / (40MHz × 60)
3486 // Note: It's recommended to leave scaling at 1 and handle conversion externally
3487 uint16_t velocityScalingFactor = 1; // Default: no internal scaling
3488 uint32_t cpr = 0; // Counts per mechanical revolution (used later for meter threshold)
3489
3490 // Always calculate CPR (needed for meter threshold calculation even if scaling is provided)
3491 uint8_t pole_pairs = 1;
3492 if (config.motor_polePairs.has_value()) {
3493 pole_pairs = config.motor_polePairs.value();
3494 } else {
3495 // Read from MotorConfig
3496 uint32_t motorTypeVal, polePairsVal;
3497 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_TYPE, motorTypeVal) &&
3498 driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS, polePairsVal)) {
3499 pole_pairs = static_cast<uint8_t>(polePairsVal);
3500 }
3501 }
3502
3503 // Calculate CPR based on sensor type
3504 switch (config.sensorSelection) {
3505 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::SAME_AS_COMMUTATION:
3506 // CPR = 2^16 × motorPolePairs
3507 cpr = static_cast<uint32_t>(65536UL * pole_pairs);
3508 break;
3509 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::DIGITAL_HALL:
3510 // CPR = 6 × motorPolePairs
3511 cpr = static_cast<uint32_t>(6 * pole_pairs);
3512 break;
3513 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN1_ENCODER:
3514 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN2_ENCODER:
3515 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::SPI_ENCODER:
3516 // CPR = encoderCountsPerRev (from encoder datasheet)
3517 if (config.encoderCountsPerRev.has_value()) {
3518 cpr = config.encoderCountsPerRev.value();
3519 }
3520 // If not provided, cpr remains 0
3521 break;
3522 }
3523
3524 // Calculate or use provided scaling factor
3525 if (config.velocityScalingFactor.has_value()) {
3526 // User provided explicit scaling factor
3527 velocityScalingFactor = config.velocityScalingFactor.value();
3528 } else if (cpr > 0) {
3529 // Auto-calculate scaling factor from CPR
3530 // Formula: k_RPM = (CPR × 2^24) / (40MHz × 60)
3531 constexpr float CONST_40MHZ_60 = 2400000000.0f; // 40MHz × 60
3532 constexpr float CONST_2_24 = 16777216.0f; // 2^24
3533
3534 float k_rpm = (static_cast<float>(cpr) * CONST_2_24) / CONST_40MHZ_60;
3535 velocityScalingFactor = static_cast<uint16_t>(k_rpm + 0.5f);
3536
3537 // Clamp to valid range [1-2047]
3538 if (velocityScalingFactor < 1)
3539 velocityScalingFactor = 1;
3540 if (velocityScalingFactor > 2047)
3541 velocityScalingFactor = 2047;
3542 }
3543 // If cpr == 0 and no explicit scaling, use default scaling factor of 1
3544
3545 ok &= setVelocityScalingFactor(velocityScalingFactor);
3546
3547 // Step 5: Configure velocity loop downsampling
3548 ok &= setVelocityLoopDownsampling(config.loopDownsampling);
3549
3550 // Step 6: Configure velocity reached threshold
3551 // Note: VELOCITY_REACHED_THRESHOLD is not a configurable parameter in TMC9660.
3552 // The VELOCITY_REACHED flag is set when both actual and target velocity are below
3553 // an internal threshold. The config.velocityReachedThreshold value is ignored.
3554 // (Parameter 134 is STOP_ON_VELOCITY_DEVIATION, not VELOCITY_REACHED_THRESHOLD)
3555
3556 // Step 7: Configure stop on deviation if enabled
3557 if (config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.has_value()) {
3558 ok &= setStopOnVelocityDeviation(config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.value(),
3559 config.stopOnDeviationSoftStop);
3560 }
3561
3562 // Step 8: Configure velocity meter switch threshold
3563 // Auto-calculate optimal threshold if not provided
3564 uint32_t meterThreshold = 2000; // Default value
3565
3566 if (config.meterSwitchThreshold.has_value()) {
3567 meterThreshold = config.meterSwitchThreshold.value();
3568 } else if (cpr > 0) {
3569 // Auto-calculate optimal switchover point
3570 // Need: CPR (already calculated in Step 4), PWM frequency, loop downsampling, and velocity
3571 // scaling factor
3572
3573 // Get PWM frequency
3574 uint32_t pwmFreq = 25000; // Default 25kHz
3575 if (config.pwmFrequency_Hz.has_value()) {
3576 pwmFreq = config.pwmFrequency_Hz.value();
3577 } else {
3578 uint32_t pwmFreqVal;
3579 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_PWM_FREQUENCY, pwmFreqVal)) {
3580 pwmFreq = pwmFreqVal;
3581 }
3582 }
3583
3584 // Calculate velocity loop frequency
3585 // From datasheet: velocity loop frequency depends on PWM frequency and downsampling
3586 // f_Velo = f_PWM / (VELOCITY_LOOP_DOWNSAMPLING + 1)
3587 // Note: This is the actual execution frequency of the velocity control loop
3588 float f_velo = static_cast<float>(pwmFreq) / static_cast<float>(config.loopDownsampling + 1);
3589
3590 // Calculate optimal switchover threshold if we have CPR
3591 if (cpr > 0) {
3592 // Formula 1: v_PerLim_RPM = 0.9 × (40MHz) / (CPR × 60 × 53)
3593 constexpr float CONST_40MHZ = 40000000.0f;
3594 float v_per_lim_rpm = 0.9f * CONST_40MHZ / (static_cast<float>(cpr) * 60.0f * 53.0f);
3595
3596 // Formula 2: v_COP_RPM = 60 × (f_Velo + sqrt(f_Velo² + f_Velo × 40MHz × 8)) / (4 × CPR)
3597 float f_velo_sq = f_velo * f_velo;
3598 float sqrt_term = std::sqrt(f_velo_sq + f_velo * CONST_40MHZ * 8.0f);
3599 float v_cop_rpm = 60.0f * (f_velo + sqrt_term) / (4.0f * static_cast<float>(cpr));
3600
3601 // Choose the smaller value
3602 float v_thr_rpm = std::min(v_per_lim_rpm, v_cop_rpm);
3603
3604 // Convert to internal units: threshold = v_THR_RPM × k_RPM
3605 float threshold = v_thr_rpm * static_cast<float>(velocityScalingFactor);
3606 meterThreshold = static_cast<uint32_t>(threshold + 0.5f);
3607
3608 // Clamp to valid range [0-134217727]
3609 if (meterThreshold > 134217727U)
3610 meterThreshold = 134217727U;
3611 }
3612 // If cpr == 0, use default threshold of 2000
3613 }
3614
3615 ok &= setVelocityMeterSwitchThreshold(meterThreshold);
3616 ok &= setVelocityMeterSwitchHysteresis(config.meterHysteresis);
3617
3618 // Step 9: Configure velocity offset (raw internal units; this autoconfig
3619 // path bypasses the engineering-units API by design — the offset is set
3620 // alongside the velocity-scaling factor in raw form for consistency).
3621 ok &= setVelocityOffsetRaw(config.velocityOffset);
3622
3623 // Step 10: Configure velocity biquad filter
3624 // Note: Velocity biquad filter is enabled by default in hardware for noise reduction
3625 if (config.enableVelocityBiquadFilter.has_value()) {
3626 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterEnable(config.enableVelocityBiquadFilter.value());
3627 }
3628 // If not explicitly set, filter remains in its default state (enabled)
3629
3630 // Configure velocity biquad filter coefficients if provided
3631 // Note: Coefficients are in Q4.20 format (24-bit, 4 integer + 20 fractional bits)
3632 // Default values if not provided: Hardware-optimized defaults for velocity noise reduction
3633 if (config.velocityBiquadACoeff1.has_value()) {
3634 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterACoeff1(config.velocityBiquadACoeff1.value());
3635 }
3636 if (config.velocityBiquadACoeff2.has_value()) {
3637 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterACoeff2(config.velocityBiquadACoeff2.value());
3638 }
3639 if (config.velocityBiquadBCoeff0.has_value()) {
3640 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterBCoeff0(config.velocityBiquadBCoeff0.value());
3641 }
3642 if (config.velocityBiquadBCoeff1.has_value()) {
3643 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterBCoeff1(config.velocityBiquadBCoeff1.value());
3644 }
3645 if (config.velocityBiquadBCoeff2.has_value()) {
3646 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterBCoeff2(config.velocityBiquadBCoeff2.value());
3647 }
3648
3649 return ok;
3650}

4052//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4053// Auto-Configuration
4054//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4055
4056template <typename CommType>
4057bool TMC9660<CommType>::PositionControl::configureAuto(const PositionConfig& config) noexcept {
4058 bool ok = true;
4059
4060 // Step 1: Configure position sensor selection
4061 ok &= setPositionSensor(config.sensorSelection);
4062
4063 // Step 2: Configure PI gains (use provided values or defaults)
4064 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_P = 2000; // Default P gain (typical for position control)
4065 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I = 100; // Default I gain (typical for position control)
4066
4067 uint16_t positionP = config.positionP.value_or(DEFAULT_P);
4068 uint16_t positionI = config.positionI.value_or(DEFAULT_I);
4069
4070 // Clamp to valid range [0-32767]
4071 if (positionP > 32767)
4072 positionP = 32767;
4073 if (positionI > 32767)
4074 positionI = 32767;
4075 if (positionI < 1)
4076 positionI = 1; // Minimum I gain
4077
4078 ok &= setPositionLoopGains(positionP, positionI);
4079
4080 // Step 3: Configure normalization
4081 ok &= setPositionNormalization(config.pNormalization, config.iNormalization);
4082
4083 // Step 4: Configure position scaling factor
4084 if (config.positionScalingFactor.has_value()) {
4085 ok &= setPositionScalingFactor(config.positionScalingFactor.value());
4086 } else if (config.encoderCountsPerRev.has_value()) {
4087 // Auto-calculate scaling factor from encoder CPR
4088 // Similar to velocity scaling, use simplified calculation
4089 uint32_t cpr = config.encoderCountsPerRev.value();
4090 if (cpr > 0) {
4091 // Simplified: assume 1:1 scaling for now (user should provide explicit scaling if needed)
4092 ok &= setPositionScalingFactor(1);
4093 }
4094 }
4095
4096 // Step 5: Configure position loop downsampling
4097 ok &= setPositionLoopDownsampling(config.loopDownsampling);
4098
4099 // Step 6: Configure position limits if provided
4100 if (config.positionLimitLow.has_value()) {
4101 ok &= setPositionLimitLow(config.positionLimitLow.value());
4102 }
4103 if (config.positionLimitHigh.has_value()) {
4104 ok &= setPositionLimitHigh(config.positionLimitHigh.value());
4105 }
4106
4107 // Step 7: Configure position reached threshold
4108 ok &= setPositionReachedThreshold(config.positionReachedThreshold);
4109
4110 // Step 8: Configure stop on deviation if enabled
4111 if (config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.has_value()) {
4112 ok &= setStopOnPositionDeviation(config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.value(),
4113 config.stopOnDeviationSoftStop);
4114 }
4115
4116 return ok;
4117}

4513//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4514// Auto-Configuration
4515//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4516
4517template <typename CommType>
4518bool TMC9660<CommType>::Ramp::configureAuto(const RampConfig& config) noexcept {
4519 bool ok = true;
4520
4521 // Step 1: Configure acceleration segments
4522 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_AMAX = 1000;
4523 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_A1 = 8000;
4524 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_A2 = 4000;
4525
4526 uint32_t aMax = config.maxAcceleration.value_or(DEFAULT_AMAX);
4527 uint32_t a1 = config.acceleration1.value_or(DEFAULT_A1);
4528 uint32_t a2 = config.acceleration2.value_or(DEFAULT_A2);
4529
4530 ok &= setAcceleration(a1, a2, aMax);
4531
4532 // Step 2: Configure deceleration segments
4533 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_DMAX = 1000;
4534 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_D1 = 8000;
4535 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_D2 = 8000;
4536
4537 uint32_t dMax = config.maxDeceleration.value_or(DEFAULT_DMAX);
4538 uint32_t d1 = config.deceleration1.value_or(DEFAULT_D1);
4539 uint32_t d2 = config.deceleration2.value_or(DEFAULT_D2);
4540
4541 ok &= setDeceleration(d1, d2, dMax);
4542
4543 // Step 3: Configure velocity thresholds and limits
4544 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_V1 = 0;
4545 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_V2 = 0;
4546 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_VSTART = 0;
4547 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_VSTOP = 1;
4548
4549 uint32_t v1 = config.velocityThreshold1.value_or(DEFAULT_V1);
4550 uint32_t v2 = config.velocityThreshold2.value_or(DEFAULT_V2);
4551 uint32_t vStart = config.startVelocity.value_or(DEFAULT_VSTART);
4552 uint32_t vStop = config.stopVelocity.value_or(DEFAULT_VSTOP);
4553 uint32_t vMax = config.maxVelocity; // Required parameter, no default
4554
4555 ok &= setVelocities(vStart, vStop, v1, v2, vMax);
4556
4557 // Step 4: Configure timing constraints
4558 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_TVMAX = 0;
4559 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_TZEROWAIT = 0;
4560
4561 uint16_t tVmax = config.timeAtVmax.value_or(DEFAULT_TVMAX);
4562 uint16_t tZeroWait = config.timeZeroWait.value_or(DEFAULT_TZEROWAIT);
4563
4564 ok &= setTiming(tVmax, tZeroWait);
4565
4566 // Step 5: Configure feedforward
4567 constexpr bool DEFAULT_VEL_FF = false;
4568 constexpr bool DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF = false;
4569 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_GAIN = 8;
4570 constexpr tmc9660::tmcl::AccelerationFFShift DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_SHIFT =
4571 tmc9660::tmcl::AccelerationFFShift::SHIFT_4_BIT;
4572
4573 bool enableVelFF = config.enableVelocityFeedForward.value_or(DEFAULT_VEL_FF);
4574 bool enableAccelFF = config.enableAccelerationFeedForward.value_or(DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF);
4575 uint16_t accelFFGain = config.accelerationFeedForwardGain.value_or(DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_GAIN);
4576 tmc9660::tmcl::AccelerationFFShift accelFFShift =
4577 config.accelerationFeedForwardShift.value_or(DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_SHIFT);
4578
4579 ok &= enableFeedForward(enableVelFF, enableAccelFF, accelFFGain, accelFFShift);
4580
4581 // Step 6: Configure direct velocity mode
4582 constexpr bool DEFAULT_DIRECT_VEL_MODE = true;
4583 bool enableDirectVel = config.enableDirectVelocityMode.value_or(DEFAULT_DIRECT_VEL_MODE);
4584
4585 ok &= setDirectVelocityMode(enableDirectVel);
4586
4587 // Step 7: Enable/disable ramp generator (applied last)
4588 if (config.enableRamp.has_value()) {
4589 ok &= enable(config.enableRamp.value());
4590 }
4591
4592 return ok;
4593}

4595//***************************************************************************
4596//** SUBSYSTEM: Step/Dir Input Extrapolation **//
4597//***************************************************************************
4598
4599namespace detail {
4600// Capability gate for Step/Dir methods: NR 205..209 + VELOCITY_FEEDFORWARD_ENABLE all return
4601// REPLY_CMD_NOT_AVAILABLE when the bootloader has stepDir.enable=false. This helper logs once
4602// per blocked call and returns false so callers can short-circuit cleanly.
4603template <typename Driver>
4604inline bool tmc9660_require_step_dir(Driver& driver, const char* where) noexcept {
4605 if (driver.capabilities().stepDir) {
4606 return true;
4607 }
4608 driver.comm().logDebug(
4609 0, "TMC9660",
4610 "StepDir::%s: subsystem disabled — set BootloaderConfig.stepDir.enable=true "
4611 "(and re-run bootloader) to use Step/Dir input.",
4612 where);
4613 return false;
4614}
4615} // namespace detail

4743//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4744// Auto-Configuration
4745//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4746
4747template <typename CommType>
4748bool TMC9660<CommType>::Brake::configureAuto(const BrakeConfig& config) noexcept {
4749 bool ok = true;
4750
4751 // Step 1: Configure brake chopper (if enabled)
4752 if (config.enableChopper.has_value() && config.enableChopper.value()) {
4753 ok &= enableChopper(true);
4754
4755 constexpr float DEFAULT_CHOPPER_VOLTAGE_V = 30.0f; // Default for 24V systems
4756 constexpr float DEFAULT_CHOPPER_HYSTERESIS_V = 2.0f;
4757
4758 float chopperVoltage = config.chopperVoltageThreshold_V.value_or(DEFAULT_CHOPPER_VOLTAGE_V);
4759 float chopperHyst = config.chopperHysteresis_V.value_or(DEFAULT_CHOPPER_HYSTERESIS_V);
4760
4761 // Clamp voltage to valid range [5.0-100.0V]
4762 if (chopperVoltage < 5.0f)
4763 chopperVoltage = 5.0f;
4764 if (chopperVoltage > 100.0f)
4765 chopperVoltage = 100.0f;
4766
4767 // Clamp hysteresis to valid range [0.0-5.0V]
4768 if (chopperHyst < 0.0f)
4769 chopperHyst = 0.0f;
4770 if (chopperHyst > 5.0f)
4771 chopperHyst = 5.0f;
4772
4773 ok &= setVoltageLimit(chopperVoltage);
4774 ok &= setHysteresis(chopperHyst);
4775 } else if (config.enableChopper.has_value() && !config.enableChopper.value()) {
4776 ok &= enableChopper(false);
4777 }
4778 // If enableChopper is not provided, leave chopper in current state
4779
4780 // Step 2: Configure mechanical brake parameters (if provided)
4781 // Note: Default values are currently unused but kept for future use
4782 // constexpr uint8_t DEFAULT_RELEASING_DUTY = 50;
4783 // constexpr uint8_t DEFAULT_HOLDING_DUTY = 30;
4784 // constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_RELEASING_DURATION_MS = 100;
4785 // constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_OUTPUT = false;
4786
4787 if (config.releasingDutyCycle.has_value()) {
4788 uint8_t duty = config.releasingDutyCycle.value();
4789 if (duty > 99)
4790 duty = 99; // Clamp to valid range
4791 ok &= setReleasingDutyCycle(duty);
4792 }
4793
4794 if (config.holdingDutyCycle.has_value()) {
4795 uint8_t duty = config.holdingDutyCycle.value();
4796 if (duty > 99)
4797 duty = 99; // Clamp to valid range
4798 ok &= setHoldingDutyCycle(duty);
4799 }
4800
4801 if (config.releasingDuration_ms.has_value()) {
4802 ok &= setReleasingDuration(config.releasingDuration_ms.value());
4803 }
4804
4805 if (config.invertOutput.has_value()) {
4806 ok &= invertOutput(config.invertOutput.value());
4807 }
4808
4809 return ok;
4810}

4814//***************************************************************************
4815
4816template <typename CommType>
4817bool TMC9660<CommType>::IIT::configure(uint16_t timeConstant1_ms, float continuousCurrent1_A,
4818 uint16_t timeConstant2_ms, float continuousCurrent2_A) noexcept {
4819 bool ok = true;
4820 ok &= setThermalWindingTimeConstant1(timeConstant1_ms);
4821 const uint32_t limit1 =
4822 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent1_A * continuousCurrent1_A * timeConstant1_ms);
4823 ok &= setLimit1(limit1);
4824 ok &= setThermalWindingTimeConstant2(timeConstant2_ms);
4825 const uint32_t limit2 =
4826 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent2_A * continuousCurrent2_A * timeConstant2_ms);
4827 ok &= setLimit2(limit2);
4828 return ok;
4829}

4990//***************************************************************************
4991//** Motor context (chip-side facts) **//
4992//***************************************************************************
4993
4994template <typename CommType>
4995bool TMC9660<CommType>::getMotorContext(::tmc9660::units::MotorContext& ctx) noexcept {
4996 // Defaults — leave a usable context if any read fails.
4997 ctx = ::tmc9660::units::MotorContext{};
4998
4999 bool all_ok = true;
5000
5001 // Motor type (NR 8). Step/Dir-only firmware may NACK; not fatal.
5002 uint32_t mt = static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR);
5003 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_TYPE, mt)) {
5004 ctx.motor_type = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType>(mt);
5005 } else {
5006 all_ok = false;
5007 }
5008
5009 // Pole pairs (NR 9). For steppers the bootloader writes
5010 // full_steps_per_rev/4 here, so the same field works for both motor types.
5011 uint32_t pp = 1;
5012 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS, pp)) {
5013 ctx.pole_pairs = static_cast<uint8_t>(pp == 0 ? 1u : pp);
5014 } else {
5015 all_ok = false;
5016 }
5017
5018 // Velocity sensor selection (NR 132).
5019 uint32_t vsel = static_cast<uint32_t>(
5020 tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::SAME_AS_COMMUTATION);
5021 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::VELOCITY_SENSOR_SELECTION, vsel)) {
5022 ctx.velocity_sensor = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection>(vsel);
5023 } else {
5024 all_ok = false;
5025 }
5026
5027 // Encoder CPR — only relevant when an encoder is selected for velocity.
5028 // NR 175 = ABN_1_STEPS, NR 178 = ABN_2_STEPS. SPI encoders' CPR is
5029 // configured at bootloader time; expose it via setMotorContextHint() if
5030 // the chip cannot self-report it.
5031 switch (ctx.velocity_sensor) {
5032 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN1_ENCODER: {
5033 uint32_t steps = 0;
5034 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::ABN_1_STEPS, steps)) {
5035 ctx.encoder_cpr = steps;
5036 } else {
5037 all_ok = false;
5038 }
5039 break;
5040 }
5041 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN2_ENCODER: {
5042 uint32_t steps = 0;
5043 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::ABN_2_STEPS, steps)) {
5044 ctx.encoder_cpr = steps;
5045 } else {
5046 all_ok = false;
5047 }
5048 break;
5049 }
5050 default:
5051 // SAME_AS_COMMUTATION / DIGITAL_HALL: CPR derived from pole pairs;
5052 // SPI_ENCODER: bootloader-side, leave at default unless caller hints.
5053 break;
5054 }
5055
5056 return all_ok;
5057}
5058
5059//***************************************************************************
5060//** SUBSYSTEM: Diagnostics **//
5061//***************************************************************************
5062
5063template <typename CommType>
5064bool TMC9660<CommType>::Diagnostics::summary(
5065 ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSummary& out,
5066 ::tmc9660::units::MotorContext const& ctx) noexcept {
5067 out = ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSummary{};
5068
5069 // Bus / thermal — convenience getters always return a value (negative on error).
5070 out.vbus_volts = driver.telemetry.getSupplyVoltage();
5071 out.chip_temp_c = driver.telemetry.getChipTemperature();
5072
5073 // Mode
5074 uint32_t cm = 0;
5075 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::COMMUTATION_MODE, cm)) {
5076 out.commutation_mode = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::CommutationMode>(cm);
5077 out.valid_commutation_mode = true;
5078 }
5079
5080 // Velocity (target + actual)
5081 bool vel_ok = true;
5082 uint32_t tv = 0;
5083 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::TARGET_VELOCITY, tv)) {
5084 out.target_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
5085 static_cast<double>(static_cast<int32_t>(tv)),
5086 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
5087 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
5088 } else {
5089 vel_ok = false;
5090 }
5091 int32_t av = 0;
5092 if (driver.velocityControl.getActualVelocity(av)) {
5093 out.actual_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
5094 static_cast<double>(av),
5095 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
5096 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
5097 } else {
5098 vel_ok = false;
5099 }
5100 out.valid_velocity = vel_ok;
5101
5102 // Status / error registers
5103 uint32_t gen_status = 0, gen_err = 0, gd_err = 0, adc_err = 0;
5104 (void)driver.telemetry.getGeneralStatusFlags(gen_status);
5105 if (driver.telemetry.getGeneralErrorFlags(gen_err)) {
5106 out.general_error_flags = gen_err;
5107 out.has_general_error = (gen_err != 0u);
5108 }
5109 if (driver.telemetry.getGateDriverErrorFlags(gd_err)) {
5110 out.gate_driver_error_flags = gd_err;
5111 out.has_gate_driver_error = (gd_err != 0u);
5112 }
5113 if (driver.telemetry.getADCStatusFlags(adc_err)) {
5114 out.adc_status_flags = adc_err;
5115 out.has_adc_clipping = (adc_err != 0u);
5116 }
5117
5118 // Decode headline regulating bits (see GeneralStatusFlags FLAG layout).
5119 constexpr uint32_t kRegulationVelocityBit = 1u << 2;
5120 constexpr uint32_t kVelocityReachedBit = 1u << 10;
5121 out.regulating_velocity = (gen_status & kRegulationVelocityBit) != 0u;
5122 out.velocity_reached = (gen_status & kVelocityReachedBit) != 0u;
5123
5124 return true;
5125}
5126
5127template <typename CommType>
5128bool TMC9660<CommType>::Diagnostics::snapshot(
5129 ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSnapshot& out,
5130 ::tmc9660::units::MotorContext const& ctx) noexcept {
5131 out = ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSnapshot{};
5132 out.context = ctx;
5133
5134 // Bus / thermal
5135 out.vbus_volts = driver.telemetry.getSupplyVoltage();
5136 out.chip_temp_c = driver.telemetry.getChipTemperature();
5137 out.external_temp_raw = driver.telemetry.getExternalTemperature();
5138
5139 // Mode
5140 uint32_t cm = 0;
5141 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::COMMUTATION_MODE, cm)) {
5142 out.commutation_mode = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::CommutationMode>(cm);
5143 out.valid_commutation_mode = true;
5144 }
5145
5146 // Velocity (target / actual / ramp), in raw + RPM
5147 uint32_t tv = 0;
5148 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::TARGET_VELOCITY, tv)) {
5149 out.target_velocity_internal = static_cast<int32_t>(tv);
5150 }
5151 int32_t av = 0;
5152 (void)driver.velocityControl.getActualVelocity(av);
5153 out.actual_velocity_internal = av;
5154 int32_t rv = 0;
5155 (void)driver.ramp.getRampVelocity(rv);
5156 out.ramp_velocity_internal = rv;
5157 out.target_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
5158 static_cast<double>(out.target_velocity_internal),
5159 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
5160 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
5161 out.actual_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
5162 static_cast<double>(out.actual_velocity_internal),
5163 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
5164 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
5165 out.ramp_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
5166 static_cast<double>(out.ramp_velocity_internal),
5167 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
5168 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
5169
5170 // Position
5171 int32_t p = 0;
5172 (void)driver.positionControl.getActualPosition(p);
5173 out.actual_position_counts = p;
5174 out.actual_position_revs = ::tmc9660::units::convertPosition(
5175 static_cast<double>(p), ::tmc9660::units::PositionUnit::Counts,
5176 ::tmc9660::units::PositionUnit::MechRevs, ctx);
5177 out.actual_position_deg_mech = out.actual_position_revs * 360.0;
5178
5179 // Electrical angle (PHI_E). Open-loop angle is the safest source while in
5180 // FOC_OPENLOOP_*; in sensored modes the chip mirrors active feedback there.
5181 int16_t phi = 0;
5182 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getOpenloopAngle(phi);
5183 out.phi_e_internal = phi;
5184 out.phi_e_deg_elec = ::tmc9660::units::convertAngle(
5185 static_cast<double>(phi), ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::PhiERaw,
5186 ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::DegElec, ctx);
5187 out.phi_e_deg_mech = ::tmc9660::units::convertAngle(
5188 static_cast<double>(phi), ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::PhiERaw,
5189 ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::DegMech, ctx);
5190
5191 // FOC currents / voltages (best-effort)
5192 out.motor_current_ma = driver.telemetry.getMotorCurrent();
5193 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentIq(out.iq_ma);
5194 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentUx(out.i_ux);
5195 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentV (out.i_v);
5196 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentWy(out.i_wy);
5197 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageUq(out.uq);
5198 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageUx(out.u_ux);
5199 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageV (out.u_v);
5200 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageWy(out.u_wy);
5201
5202 // Status / error registers
5203 (void)driver.telemetry.getGeneralStatusFlags (out.general_status_flags);
5204 (void)driver.telemetry.getGeneralErrorFlags (out.general_error_flags);
5205 (void)driver.telemetry.getGateDriverErrorFlags(out.gate_driver_error_flags);
5206 (void)driver.telemetry.getADCStatusFlags (out.adc_status_flags);
5207
5208 // Decode convenience bits (see GeneralStatusFlags FLAG layout).
5209 constexpr uint32_t kRegulationTorqueBit = 1u << 1;
5210 constexpr uint32_t kRegulationVelocityBit = 1u << 2;
5211 constexpr uint32_t kVelocityReachedBit = 1u << 10;
5212 out.regulating_torque = (out.general_status_flags & kRegulationTorqueBit) != 0u;
5213 out.regulating_velocity = (out.general_status_flags & kRegulationVelocityBit) != 0u;
5214 out.velocity_reached = (out.general_status_flags & kVelocityReachedBit) != 0u;
5215
5216 return true;
5217}

5219//***************************************************************************
5220//** SUBSYSTEM: Stop / Event **//
5221//***************************************************************************
5222
5223template <typename CommType>
5224bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::enableDeviationStop(uint32_t maxVelError, uint32_t maxPosError,
5225 bool softStop) noexcept {
5226 bool ok = true;
5227 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::STOP_ON_VELOCITY_DEVIATION, maxVelError);
5228 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::STOP_ON_POSITION_DEVIATION, maxPosError);
5229
5230 using tmc9660::tmcl::EventStopSettings;
5231 bool vel = maxVelError != 0;
5232 bool pos = maxPosError != 0;
5233 EventStopSettings setting = EventStopSettings::DO_HARD_STOP;
5234 if (vel && pos)
5235 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_VEL_DEVIATION_SOFT_STOP
5236 : EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_VEL_DEVIATION;
5237 else if (pos)
5238 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_DEVIATION_SOFT_STOP
5239 : EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_DEVIATION;
5240 else if (vel)
5241 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_VEL_DEVIATION_SOFT_STOP
5242 : EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_VEL_DEVIATION;
5243 else
5244 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::DO_SOFT_STOP : EventStopSettings::DO_HARD_STOP;
5245
5246 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::EVENT_STOP_SETTINGS,
5247 static_cast<uint32_t>(setting));
5248 return ok;
5249}
5250
5251template <typename CommType>
5252bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::configureReferenceSwitches(uint8_t mask, bool invertL, bool invertR,
5253 bool invertH, bool swapLR) noexcept {
5254 bool ok = true;
5255 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::REFERENCE_SWITCH_ENABLE, mask);
5256 uint8_t cfg =
5257 (invertL ? 1u : 0u) | (invertR ? 2u : 0u) | (invertH ? 4u : 0u) | (swapLR ? 8u : 0u);
5258 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::REFERENCE_SWITCH_POLARITY_AND_SWAP, cfg);
5259 return ok;
5260}
5261
5262template <typename CommType>
5263bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::getAndClearLatchedPosition(int32_t& pos) noexcept {
5264 uint32_t v;
5265 if (!driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::LATCH_POSITION, v))
5266 return false;
5267 pos = static_cast<int32_t>(v);
5268 return driver.writeParameter(
5269 tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::GENERAL_STATUS_FLAGS,
5270 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags::RAMPER_LATCHED));
5271}
5272
5273//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5274// Auto-Configuration
5275//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5276
5277template <typename CommType>
5278bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::configureAuto(const StopEventsConfig& config) noexcept {
5279 bool ok = true;
5280
5281 // Step 1: Configure deviation stop (if enabled)
5282 if (config.maxVelocityDeviation.has_value() || config.maxPositionDeviation.has_value()) {
5283 constexpr bool DEFAULT_SOFT_STOP = true;
5284 uint32_t maxVelError = config.maxVelocityDeviation.value_or(0);
5285 uint32_t maxPosError = config.maxPositionDeviation.value_or(0);
5286 bool softStop = config.deviationSoftStop.value_or(DEFAULT_SOFT_STOP);
5287
5288 ok &= enableDeviationStop(maxVelError, maxPosError, softStop);
5289 }
5290
5291 // Step 2: Configure reference switches (if enabled)
5292 if (config.referenceSwitchMask.has_value()) {
5293 constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_L = false;
5294 constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_R = false;
5295 constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_H = false;
5296 constexpr bool DEFAULT_SWAP_LR = false;
5297
5298 uint8_t mask = config.referenceSwitchMask.value();
5299 // Clamp mask to valid range [0-7]
5300 if (mask > 7)
5301 mask = 7;
5302
5303 bool invertL = config.invertLeftSwitch.value_or(DEFAULT_INVERT_L);
5304 bool invertR = config.invertRightSwitch.value_or(DEFAULT_INVERT_R);
5305 bool invertH = config.invertHomeSwitch.value_or(DEFAULT_INVERT_H);
5306 bool swapLR = config.swapLeftRight.value_or(DEFAULT_SWAP_LR);
5307
5308 ok &= configureReferenceSwitches(mask, invertL, invertR, invertH, swapLR);
5309 }
5310
5311 return ok;
5312}

5315//== SUBSYSTEM: Protection ==//
5316//===========================================================================
5317
5318template <typename CommType>
5319bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureVoltage(uint16_t overVoltThreshold,
5320 uint16_t underVoltThreshold) noexcept {
5321 bool ok = true;
5322 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SUPPLY_OVERVOLTAGE_WARNING_THRESHOLD,
5323 static_cast<uint32_t>(overVoltThreshold));
5324 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SUPPLY_UNDERVOLTAGE_WARNING_THRESHOLD,
5325 static_cast<uint32_t>(underVoltThreshold));
5326 return ok;
5327}
5328
5329template <typename CommType>
5330bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureTemperature(float warningDegC, float shutdownDegC) noexcept {
5331 // Convert Celsius to raw sensor units: val = (Temp + 268.15) / 0.01615
5332 float warnVal = (warningDegC + 268.15f) / 0.01615f;
5333 float shutVal = (shutdownDegC + 268.15f) / 0.01615f;
5334 if (warnVal < 0)
5335 warnVal = 0;
5336 if (warnVal > 65535)
5337 warnVal = 65535;
5338 if (shutVal < 0)
5339 shutVal = 0;
5340 if (shutVal > 65535)
5341 shutVal = 65535;
5342 uint16_t warnRaw = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::lround(warnVal));
5343 uint16_t shutRaw = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::lround(shutVal));
5344 bool ok = true;
5345 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::CHIP_TEMPERATURE_WARNING_THRESHOLD,
5346 static_cast<uint32_t>(warnRaw));
5347 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::CHIP_TEMPERATURE_SHUTDOWN_THRESHOLD,
5348 static_cast<uint32_t>(shutRaw));
5349 return ok;
5350}
5351
5352template <typename CommType>
5353bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::setOvercurrentEnabled(bool enabled) noexcept {
5354 using tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable;
5355 using tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters;
5356 const OvercurrentEnable temp =
5357 enabled ? OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED : OvercurrentEnable::DISABLED;
5358 const uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(temp);
5359 // All SAP (axis parameters). Full 4-phase path programs Y2; 3-phase BLDC stacks often omit Y2
5360 // and some firmware returns REPLY_WRONG_TYPE for Y2_* — UVW enables still apply.
5361 if (driver.gateDriver.enableOvercurrentProtection(temp, temp, temp, temp))
5362 return true;
5363 bool ok = true;
5364 ok &= driver.writeParameter(Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE, v);
5365 ok &= driver.writeParameter(Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE, v);
5366 return ok;
5367}
5368
5369template <typename CommType>
5370bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureI2t(uint16_t timeConstant1_ms, float continuousCurrent1_A,
5371 uint16_t timeConstant2_ms,
5372 float continuousCurrent2_A) noexcept {
5373 bool ok = true;
5374 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::THERMAL_WINDING_TIME_CONSTANT_1,
5375 timeConstant1_ms);
5376 uint32_t limit1 =
5377 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent1_A * continuousCurrent1_A * timeConstant1_ms);
5378 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::IIT_LIMIT_1, limit1);
5379 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::THERMAL_WINDING_TIME_CONSTANT_2,
5380 timeConstant2_ms);
5381 uint32_t limit2 =
5382 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent2_A * continuousCurrent2_A * timeConstant2_ms);
5383 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::IIT_LIMIT_2, limit2);
5384 return ok;
5385}
5386
5387template <typename CommType>
5388bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::resetI2tState() noexcept {
5389 return driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::RESET_IIT_SUMS, 1u);
5390}

5392//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5393// Auto-Configuration
5394//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5395
5396template <typename CommType>
5397bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureAuto(const ProtectionConfig& config) noexcept {
5398 bool ok = true;
5399
5400 // Step 1: Configure voltage protection
5401 constexpr float DEFAULT_OVERVOLTAGE_V = 28.0f; // Default for 24V systems
5402 constexpr float DEFAULT_UNDERVOLTAGE_V = 20.0f; // Default for 24V systems
5403
5404 float overVolt = config.overvoltageThreshold_V.value_or(DEFAULT_OVERVOLTAGE_V);
5405 float underVolt = config.undervoltageThreshold_V.value_or(DEFAULT_UNDERVOLTAGE_V);
5406
5407 // Convert volts to 0.1V units (as required by configureVoltage)
5408 uint16_t overVoltThreshold = static_cast<uint16_t>(overVolt * 10.0f + 0.5f);
5409 uint16_t underVoltThreshold = static_cast<uint16_t>(underVolt * 10.0f + 0.5f);
5410
5411 if (config.program_supply_voltage_warnings) {
5412 ok &= configureVoltage(overVoltThreshold, underVoltThreshold);
5413 }
5414
5415 // Step 2: Configure temperature protection
5416 constexpr float DEFAULT_TEMP_WARNING_C = 80.0f;
5417 constexpr float DEFAULT_TEMP_SHUTDOWN_C = 100.0f;
5418
5419 float tempWarning = config.temperatureWarning_C.value_or(DEFAULT_TEMP_WARNING_C);
5420 float tempShutdown = config.temperatureShutdown_C.value_or(DEFAULT_TEMP_SHUTDOWN_C);
5421
5422 if (config.program_chip_temperature_warnings) {
5423 ok &= configureTemperature(tempWarning, tempShutdown);
5424 }
5425
5426 // Step 3: Configure overcurrent protection (gate-driver OC enable SAPs)
5427 if (config.program_gate_driver_overcurrent_enable) {
5428 constexpr bool DEFAULT_OVERCURRENT_ENABLED = true;
5429 bool enableOC = config.enableOvercurrent.value_or(DEFAULT_OVERCURRENT_ENABLED);
5430 ok &= setOvercurrentEnabled(enableOC);
5431 }
5432
5433 // Step 4: Configure I²t thermal protection
5434 if (config.program_i2t_limits) {
5435 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I2T_TIME1_MS = 100;
5436 constexpr float DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT1_A = 1.5f;
5437 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I2T_TIME2_MS = 1000;
5438 constexpr float DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT2_A = 1.25f;
5439
5440 uint16_t time1 = config.i2tTimeConstant1_ms.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_TIME1_MS);
5441 float current1 = config.i2tContinuousCurrent1_A.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT1_A);
5442 uint16_t time2 = config.i2tTimeConstant2_ms.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_TIME2_MS);
5443 float current2 = config.i2tContinuousCurrent2_A.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT2_A);
5444
5445 ok &= configureI2t(time1, current1, time2, current2);
5446 }
5447
5448 return ok;
5449}

5451//===========================================================================
5452//== SUBSYSTEM: Script ==//
5453//===========================================================================
5454
5455template <typename CommType>
5456bool TMC9660<CommType>::Script::upload(const std::vector<uint32_t>& scriptData) noexcept {
5457 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::DownloadStart, 0, 0, 0, nullptr))
5458 return false;
5459
5460 // During download mode, scriptData contains packed TMCL operations
5461 // Each uint32_t represents one TMCL operation: [opcode, type, motor, value]
5462 // These operations will be stored to script memory instead of executed
5463 for (uint32_t packedOp : scriptData) {
5464 // Extract TMCL operation components from packed data
5465 uint8_t opcode = (packedOp >> 24) & 0xFF;
5466 uint8_t type = (packedOp >> 16) & 0xFF;
5467 uint8_t motor = (packedOp >> 8) & 0xFF;
5468 uint8_t value = packedOp & 0xFF;
5469
5470 // Send the TMCL operation - it will be stored to script memory during download mode
5471 if (!driver.sendCommand(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Op>(opcode), type, motor, value, nullptr))
5472 return false;
5473 }
5474
5475 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::DownloadEnd, 0, 0, 0, nullptr);
5476}

5583template <typename CommType>
5584bool TMC9660<CommType>::RamDebug::getState(tmc9660::tmcl::RamDebugState& state) noexcept {

5587 return false;
5588 }

5600
5601template <typename CommType>
5602bool TMC9660<CommType>::RamDebug::readSamples(uint32_t first, std::span<uint32_t> out,
5603 size_t* read) noexcept {
5604 if (read != nullptr) {
5605 *read = 0;
5606 }
5607 constexpr size_t kChunk = detail::kBatchChunk;
5608 std::array<TMCLFrame, kChunk> frames{};
5609 std::array<TMCLReply, kChunk> replies{};
5610 size_t total = 0;
5611 while (total < out.size()) {
5612 const size_t n = std::min(kChunk, out.size() - total);
5613 for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
5614 frames[i] = TMCLFrame{};
5615 frames[i].opcode = static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::RamDebug);
5616 frames[i].type = static_cast<uint16_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::RamDebugType::READ_SAMPLE);
5617 frames[i].value = first + static_cast<uint32_t>(total + i);
5618 }
5619 size_t done = 0;
5620 const bool transport_ok = driver.sendCommandBatch(
5621 std::span<const TMCLFrame>(frames.data(), n), std::span<TMCLReply>(replies.data(), n),
5622 &done);
5623 for (size_t i = 0; i < done; ++i) {
5624 if (!replies[i].isOK()) {
5625 return false; // past the captured data, or not COMPLETE yet
5626 }
5627 out[total] = replies[i].value;
5628 ++total;
5629 if (read != nullptr) {
5630 *read = total;
5631 }
5632 }
5633 if (!transport_ok || done < n) {
5634 return false;
5635 }
5636 }
5637 return true;
5638}

5665template <typename CommType>
5666bool TMC9660<CommType>::RamDebug::configure(const CaptureConfig& config) noexcept {
5667 const size_t channels = config.channelCount;
5668 if (channels == 0U || channels > kMaxChannels || config.samplesPerChannel == 0U ||
5669 config.pretriggerSamplesPerChannel > config.samplesPerChannel ||
5670 config.trigger.shift > 15U) {
5671 return false;
5672 }
5673 const uint32_t total = config.samplesPerChannel * static_cast<uint32_t>(channels);
5674 const uint32_t pretrigger =
5675 config.pretriggerSamplesPerChannel * static_cast<uint32_t>(channels);
5676 bool ok = reset();
5677 ok = ok && setSampleCount(total);
5678 ok = ok && setPrescaler(config.prescaler);
5679 for (size_t i = 0; ok && i < channels; ++i) {
5680 ok = addChannel(config.channels[i]);
5681 }
5682 ok = ok && setPretriggerCount(pretrigger);
5683 if (ok && config.trigger.type != TriggerType::UNCONDITIONAL) {
5684 ok = setTriggerMaskShift(config.trigger.mask, config.trigger.shift);
5685 ok = ok && setTriggerChannel(config.trigger.source);
5686 }
5687 return ok;
5688}

5717 state == tmc9660::tmcl::RamDebugState::CAPTURE ||

5728
5729template <typename CommType>
5730bool TMC9660<CommType>::NvmStorage::storeToFlash() noexcept {
5731 // Use STAP command with fixed fields as documented in the TMCL manual
5732 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::STAP, 0x0FFF, 0x0F, 0xFFFFFFFF, nullptr);
5733}
5734
5735template <typename CommType>
5736bool TMC9660<CommType>::NvmStorage::recallFromFlash() noexcept {
5737 // Trigger a configuration reload from external memory using FactoryDefault
5738 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::FactoryDefault, 0, 0, 0, nullptr))
5739 return false;
5740 // Give the controller some time to process and then check status flag
5741 driver.comm_.delayMs(50);
5742 uint32_t flags = 0;
5743 if (!driver.telemetry.getGeneralStatusFlags(flags))
5744 return false;
5745 constexpr uint32_t CONFIG_LOADED_MASK =
5746 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags::CONFIG_LOADED);
5747 return (flags & CONFIG_LOADED_MASK) != 0;
5748}

5751bool TMC9660<CommType>::NvmStorage::eraseFlashBank(uint8_t n) noexcept {

5753 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::FactoryDefault, n, 0, 0, nullptr);

5772template <typename CommType>
5773tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig
5774TMC9660<CommType>::Heartbeat::transportInterface() const noexcept {
5775 return (driver.comm_.mode() == CommMode::SPI)
5776 ? tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig::SPI_INTERFACE
5777 : tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig::TMCL_UART_INTERFACE;

5780template <typename CommType>
5781bool TMC9660<CommType>::Heartbeat::configureAuto(const HeartbeatConfig& config) noexcept {
5782 constexpr bool DEFAULT_ENABLE = false;
5783 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 1000;
5784
5785 const bool enable = config.enable.value_or(DEFAULT_ENABLE);
5786 const uint32_t timeout = config.timeoutMs.value_or(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS);
5787
5788 // Explicit interface, defaulting to the transport this driver talks over. Arming the UART
5789 // watchdog on an SPI board (the behaviour up to 1.0.0) monitors an idle interface.
5790 const tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig mode =
5791 enable ? config.interface.value_or(transportInterface())
5792 : tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig::DISABLED;
5793
5794 return configure(mode, timeout);
5795}

5813template <typename CommType>
5814bool TMC9660<CommType>::Power::configureAuto(const PowerConfig& config) noexcept {

5818 if (config.enableWakePin.has_value()) {
5819 ok &= enableWakePin(config.enableWakePin.value());

6014//** SUBSYSTEM: General-purpose GPIO (Digital/Analog I/O) **//
6015//***************************************************************************
6016template <typename CommType>
6017bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::setMode(uint8_t pin, bool output, bool pullEnable, bool pullUp) noexcept {
6018 if (pin > 18)
6019 return false;
6020 uint32_t bit = 1u << pin;
6021 uint32_t mask;
6022 bool ok = driver.globals.getIODirectionMask(mask);
6023 if (!ok)
6024 return false;
6025 mask = output ? (mask | bit) : (mask & ~bit);
6026 ok &= driver.globals.setIODirectionMask(mask);
6027
6028 ok &= driver.globals.getPullEnableMask(mask);
6029 if (!ok)
6030 return false;
6031 mask = pullEnable ? (mask | bit) : (mask & ~bit);
6032 ok &= driver.globals.setPullEnableMask(mask);
6033
6034 ok &= driver.globals.getPullDirectionMask(mask);
6035 if (!ok)
6036 return false;
6037 mask = pullUp ? (mask | bit) : (mask & ~bit);
6038 ok &= driver.globals.setPullDirectionMask(mask);
6039 return ok;
6040}
6041template <typename CommType>
6042bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::writePin(uint8_t pin, bool value) noexcept {
6043 if (pin > 18)
6044 return false;
6045 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SIO, pin, 0, value ? 1u : 0u, nullptr);
6046}
6047template <typename CommType>
6048bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::readDigital(uint8_t pin, bool& value) noexcept {
6049 if (pin > 18)
6050 return false;
6051 uint32_t v;
6052 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GIO, pin, 0, 0, &v))
6053 return false;
6054 value = (v != 0);
6055 return true;
6056}
6057template <typename CommType>
6058bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::readAnalog(uint8_t pin, uint16_t& value) noexcept {
6059 if (pin > 18)
6060 return false;
6061 uint32_t v;
6062 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GIO, pin, 1, 0, &v))
6063 return false;

6065 return true;
6066}
